ex: Please hand me the knife so I can slice the bread.
ex_zh: 请把刀递给我,我好切面包。
tip: chef's knife 主厨刀; paring knife 削皮刀; cleaver 切肉刀。

ex: Use a fork to pick up the salad leaves.
ex_zh: 用叉子把沙拉叶子叉起来。
tip: 餐桌三件套: fork + knife + spoon。

ex: May I have a spoon for the soup, please?
tip: tablespoon 汤匙; teaspoon 茶匙。

ex: Can you eat noodles with chopsticks?
tip: 复数,以 s 结尾,不念 /s/。a pair of chopsticks 一双筷子。

ex: Always place vegetables on the cutting board before slicing.
ex_zh: 切菜前把蔬菜放在砧板上。
tip: chopping board 也常见,英式用法。

ex: Use the spatula to flip the pancake over.
tip: rubber spatula 硅胶刮刀,常用于烘焙。

ex: She used a ladle to serve the soup.
tip: dipper 也可指长柄勺。

ex: Whisk the eggs until they become fluffy.
tip: whisk v. 也指搅打动作。

ex: Pick up the hot corn with kitchen tongs.
ex_zh: 用厨房夹子夹起烫玉米。
tip: a pair of tongs, barbecue tongs 烧烤夹。

ex: He used a peeler to remove the apple skin.
tip: vegetable peeler 更具体。

ex: Grate the cheese with a grater over the pasta.
ex_zh: 用刨丝器把奶酪擦到意面上。
tip: microplane / fine grater 细丝刨。

ex: Drain the pasta in a colander before serving.
ex_zh: 上桌前把意面在滤盆里沥干。
tip: 美式 colander,英式也称 strainer。

ex: She mixed the salad in a large bowl.
ex_zh: 她在一个大碗里拌沙拉。
tip: mixing bowl 搅拌碗。

ex: Could you pass me that plate?
tip: dinner plate 餐盘; salad plate 沙拉盘。

ex: This dish is one of my favorites.
tip: dish 既指菜也指碟子,看上下文。

ex: I drink coffee from a large mug every morning.
ex_zh: 我每天早上用大马克杯喝咖啡。
tip: mug 通常指带柄厚杯; cup 是常见杯子。

ex: She brewed jasmine tea in a small teapot.
ex_zh: 她用小茶壶泡茉莉花茶。
tip: teacup 茶杯; teapot 茶壶,搭配。

ex: Put the kettle on; we need hot water for tea.
ex_zh: 把水壶烧上,我们泡茶需要热水。
tip: electric kettle 电水壶。

ex: Heat the frying pan before adding the eggs.
tip: 美式 frying pan; 英式常用 skillet。

ex: Boil the milk in a small saucepan.
ex_zh: 在小深锅里把牛奶煮开。
tip: 煮粥煮汤用 saucepan,而不是 frying pan。

ex: Stir-fry the vegetables in a hot wok.
tip: 粤语 '镬' 演变; wok hei 锅气。

ex: The soup is still in the pot on the stove.
tip: stock pot 汤锅; pot of tea 一壶茶。

ex: Cover the pan with a lid to keep it warm.
tip: cover n. 也常用,但 lid 更具体指锅盖、盒盖。

ex: Be careful; the pan handle is hot.
tip: hand-grip 柄; knob 旋钮式把手。

ex: The soup has been cooking on the stove all morning.
ex_zh: 汤在炉子上煮了一上午。
tip: stove 美式; 英式有时用 cooker。

ex: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees before baking.
ex_zh: 烤之前把烤箱预热到 180 度。
tip: microwave oven 微波炉 = microwave。

ex: Heat the leftovers in the microwave for two minutes.
ex_zh: 剩饭在微波炉里加热两分钟。
tip: microwave v. 也指用微波炉加热。

ex: Pop the bread into the toaster for breakfast.
ex_zh: 把面包放进烤面包机里做早餐。
tip: toasted bread / toast 烤面包片。

ex: Blend the strawberries and yogurt in a blender.
ex_zh: 把草莓和酸奶放进搅拌机里打碎。
tip: blend v. 搅打; smoothie 用 blender 做。

ex: Chop the nuts quickly with a food processor.
ex_zh: 用食物处理机快速切碎坚果。
tip: 和 blender 不同:food processor 干湿通用。

ex: Keep the milk in the refrigerator overnight.
tip: 口语常用 fridge,缩写自 refrigeration。

ex: Store the meat in the freezer for later use.
tip: freezer compartment 冷冻室; 区别于 fridge。

ex: Wash the dishes in the kitchen sink.
tip: bathroom sink 浴室水池; kitchen sink 厨房水槽。

ex: Turn the faucet off after you wash your hands.
ex_zh: 洗完手后把水龙头关掉。
tip: 美式 faucet; 英式叫 tap。

ex: Squeeze some dish soap onto the sponge.
tip: washing-up liquid 英式; dishwashing liquid 美式。

ex: Scrub the counter with a wet sponge.
tip: sponge cake 海绵蛋糕。

ex: Dry the plates with a clean dish towel.
ex_zh: 用干净的洗碗布擦盘子。
tip: tea towel 英式也指同一物。

ex: Put on an apron before cooking to protect your clothes.
ex_zh: 做饭前系上围裙免得弄脏衣服。
tip: barbecue apron BBQ 围裙。

zh: 隔热手套 / 烤箱手套
ex: Use oven mitts to take the hot tray out.
ex_zh: 戴隔热手套把烤盘取出来。
tip: 英式也称 oven glove。

ex: Please use a napkin when eating fried food.
ex_zh: 吃油炸食品请用餐巾纸。
tip: paper napkin 纸餐巾; cloth napkin 布餐巾。

ex: Roll the dough flat with a rolling pin.
tip: pin 也作名词指大头针,别混。

ex: Add one cup of flour using the measuring cup.
tip: dry measuring cup 干量杯; liquid 液体量杯。

ex: One teaspoon of salt is enough.
tip: teaspoon = tsp; tablespoon = tbsp。

ex: Follow the recipe step by step.
tip: recipe book 食谱书。

ex: Fresh ingredients make the meal taste better.
tip: recipe 配方; ingredient 食材,搭配记忆。

ex: Add some seasoning to bring out the flavor.
ex_zh: 加点调味料让味道更突出。
tip: season v. 调味; seasoning n. 调味料。

ex: Pour the tea through a strainer into the cup.
ex_zh: 把茶通过滤网倒进杯子。
tip: 与 colander 区别:strainer 细密,常用于液体。

ex: Use a funnel when filling bottles with oil.
tip: funnel-shaped 漏斗状,形容词用法。

ex: She stored the jam in a glass jar.
ex_zh: 她把果酱放在一个玻璃罐里。
tip: mason jar 梅森罐;mason jar 也指储物罐。

ex: The water bottle is almost empty.
tip: water bottle 日常高频词。

ex: I keep my coffee hot in a thermos.
ex_zh: 我用保温瓶让咖啡保温。
tip: vacuum flask / thermos 同义。

ex: He carries a lunch box to the office every day.
ex_zh: 他每天带便当盒去上班。
tip: bento box 日式便当盒。

ex: Wipe the spill with a paper towel.
ex_zh: 用厨房纸巾擦掉泼出来的水。
tip: 英式常用 kitchen roll。

ex: Wrap the leftovers in cling film before refrigerating.
ex_zh: 把剩菜用保鲜膜包好再放进冰箱。
tip: 英式 cling film; 美式 plastic wrap。

ex: Cover the dish with aluminum foil before baking.
tip: 英式常用 tin foil; 高频食品包装词。

ex: Sieve the flour to remove any lumps.
tip: sieve 与 strainer 通用,看习惯。

ex: The spice rack sits on the counter near the stove.
ex_zh: 调料架放在灶台附近的台面上。
tip: rack 架; spice jar 调料瓶。

ex: Set the timer for ten minutes.
ex_zh: 把计时器设到 10 分钟。
tip: kitchen timer 厨房计时器; stopwatch 跑表。

ex: Weigh the flour on the kitchen scale.
tip: digital scale 数字秤,烘焙必备。

ex: Turn on the stove hood while frying.
ex_zh: 煎东西的时候打开抽油烟机。
tip: range hood 同义; vent hood 也是。

ex: Spread the tablecloth before setting the dishes.
tip: cloth 布料; linen 亚麻桌布。

ex: Put a placemat under each plate.
ex_zh: 每个盘子下面放一张餐垫。
tip: mat 垫; floor mat 地垫。

ex: There is a small napkin holder at the center of the table.
ex_zh: 桌子中央有一个小餐巾架。
tip: holder 支架,通用后缀。

ex: Carry the cups to the guests on a serving tray.
ex_zh: 用托盘把杯子端给客人。
tip: tray 盘; waiter's tray 服务员托盘。

ex: Pass the salt shaker, please.
tip: pepper shaker 胡椒瓶; shaker 摇瓶。

ex: Grind fresh pepper over the steak using the pepper mill.
ex_zh: 用胡椒研磨器给牛排现磨胡椒。
tip: mill 研磨机; coffee mill 咖啡研磨机。

ex: Put your glass on a coaster to protect the table.
ex_zh: 把杯子放在杯垫上保护桌面。
tip: 与 placemat 区别:coaster 单杯垫,placemat 整套餐垫。

ex: The carving knife is perfect for slicing the roast.
tip: carve v. 雕切; carving 雕切艺术(南瓜灯)。

ex: Reduce the sauce in a small sauce pan.
tip: 复数 sauce pans; 与 saucepan 拼写略有不同。

ex: Hang the kitchen towel on the oven door.
ex_zh: 把厨房毛巾挂在烤箱门上。
tip: dish towel 也行,但 kitchen towel 更通用。

ex: We are having a barbecue this weekend on the grill.
ex_zh: 这周末我们在烤架上烧烤。
tip: grill v. 也指烤的动作; grilled 烤过的。

ex: Let's invite friends for a barbecue on Saturday.
tip: BBQ 缩写常见,口语高频。

ex: She set the table with silver napkin rings.
ex_zh: 她用银色餐巾环布置餐桌。
tip: ring 环; 高级餐厅布置。

ex: Pour cold water into the glass pitcher.
tip: 美式 pitcher; 英式 jug 更常用。

ex: She sipped jasmine tea from a delicate teacup.
ex_zh: 她用精致的小茶杯喝茉莉花茶。
tip: teacup 通常指配茶壶使用的小杯。

ex: The soup bowl is hot; be careful.
tip: cereal bowl 麦片碗; rice bowl 饭碗。

ex: He raised his wine glass for a toast.
tip: red wine glass 红葡萄酒杯; champagne flute 香槟杯。

ex: The coffee maker turns on automatically at 7 a.m.
ex_zh: 咖啡机早上 7 点自动启动。
tip: espresso machine 意式咖啡机; French press 法压壶。

ex: Fill the ice cube tray with water and freeze.
tip: tray 浅盘; 区别于 baking tray 烤盘。

ex: A bowl of fresh apples sits on the table.
ex_zh: 桌上摆着一盘新鲜苹果。
tip: fruit basket 水果篮。

ex: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
ex_zh: 一天一苹果,医生远离我。
tip: 英语谚语,常作口头禅。

ex: Monkeys love eating bananas.
tip: banana peel 香蕉皮;slip on a banana peel 踩到香蕉皮滑倒。

ex: Squeeze the orange to make fresh juice.
tip: orange 既指橙子也指橘子,口语混用。

ex: This Asian pear is sweet and juicy.
ex_zh: 这个亚洲梨又甜又多汁。
tip: Asian pear 亚洲梨; pear-shape 梨形身材。

ex: The peach fuzz tickles my lips.
ex_zh: 桃子的绒毛弄得我嘴唇痒。
tip: peach fuzz 桃子绒毛; peachy 极好的(口语)。

ex: She picked ripe plums from the tree.
tip: plum job 美差事; plum 暗紫红色。

ex: A bunch of grapes hangs from the vine.
tip: a bunch of grapes 一串葡萄;grapevine 葡萄藤。

ex: Fresh strawberries taste best in summer.
tip: strawberry mark 草莓痣(皮肤红斑)。

ex: Blueberries are full of antioxidants.
tip: blueberry muffin 蓝莓马芬。

ex: Top the yogurt with fresh raspberries.
ex_zh: 在酸奶上放新鲜覆盆子。
tip: raspberry 还可作 '咂舌' 的拟声词:blow a raspberry 咂舌。

ex: I picked blackberries along the trail this morning.
ex_zh: 我今天早上沿路摘黑莓。
tip: blackberry 黑莓(手机); 注意语境。

ex: She put two cherries on top of the cake.
ex_zh: 她在蛋糕上放两颗樱桃。
tip: cherry blossom 樱花; cherry-pick 挑最好的。

ex: Cut the watermelon in half for everyone.
ex_zh: 把西瓜切成两半分给大家。
tip: watermelon sugar 夏日清新感(流行词)。

ex: Pineapple goes well with ham.
tip: pineapple chunks 菠萝块; canned pineapple 罐头菠萝。

ex: Mango sticky rice is a Thai dessert.
ex_zh: 芒果糯米饭是泰国甜点。
tip: mango lassi 芒果汁酸奶;Yogi Bear's sidekick 卡通名字。

ex: Papaya enzymes help digestion.
tip: papaya salad 泰式凉拌木瓜。

ex: A sliced kiwi shows a bright green center.
ex_zh: 切开的猕猴桃中心翠绿。
tip: kiwi bird 几维鸟(新西兰); Kiwi 也指新西兰人。

ex: Squeeze some lemon over the grilled fish.
tip: lemonade 柠檬水; life's a lemon 生活艰(俚语)。

ex: Garnish the tacos with fresh lime.
ex_zh: 用新鲜青柠给塔可饼添味。
tip: 与 lemon 区别:lime 绿皮更小;lemon 黄皮。

ex: Half a grapefruit makes a tangy breakfast.
ex_zh: 半个葡萄柚是清爽的早餐。
tip: grapefruit 与 grapes 无关,是柑橘类。

ex: Sprinkle pomegranate seeds on the salad.
tip: pomegranate juice 石榴汁。

ex: Smash the avocado for toast.
tip: avocado toast 牛油果吐司(网红早餐)。

ex: Drink fresh coconut water on the beach.
tip: coconut milk 椰浆; coconut oil 椰子油。

ex: A ripe fig is sweet and chewy.
ex_zh: 熟无花果又甜又有嚼劲。
tip: fig leaf 无花果叶(常裸体艺术遮挡)。

ex: Medjool dates are naturally sweet.
tip: date 还有 '约会' 之义,看上下文。

ex: Dried apricots are a healthy snack.
tip: apricot 来自拉丁 'praecoquum' 早熟果。

ex: Crisp Asian pears are perfect for salads.
ex_zh: 脆甜的亚洲梨配沙拉很好。
tip: Ya pear / Nashi pear 都是亚洲梨。

ex: Tangerines are easy to peel.
tip: tangerine 比 mandarin orange 略小、更红。

ex: Mandarin oranges are in season in winter.
tip: Mandarin 也指普通话 / 满大人(中国官员)。

ex: A wedge of cantaloupe goes well with prosciutto.
tip: cantaloupe 也叫 rockmelon(澳新)。

ex: Honeydew has a smooth green rind.
tip: honeydew melon 同义;honeydew 也指蜜露(蚜虫分泌物)。

ex: Cranberry sauce pairs well with turkey.
tip: 感恩节经典搭配;cranberry juice 蔓越莓汁。

ex: Passion fruit makes a tangy sorbet.
ex_zh: 百香果做冰沙酸甜可口。
tip: passion fruit 不是 passion 的果实,源自西班牙语。

ex: Dragon fruit has tiny black seeds.
tip: pitaya 同义;常红色或黄色外皮。

ex: Fresh lychees are sweet and floral.
ex_zh: 新鲜荔枝清甜带着花香。
tip: lychee nut 荔枝核; 发音 /'laɪtʃi/。

ex: Dried longan is often used in Chinese soup.
tip: longan eye 龙眼(eye 是形似的眼睛)。

ex: The smell of durian fills the entire kitchen.
ex_zh: 榴莲的气味弥漫整个厨房。
tip: the king of fruits 水果之王;部分酒店禁带。

ex: Ripe persimmons taste like honey.
tip: Japanese persimmon 富有柿; persimmon wood 柿木。

ex: Guava paste pairs with cheese in Cuba.
tip: guava 来自加勒比海。

ex: Sliced star fruit looks like a five-point star.
tip: carambola 同义(正式名)。

ex: Pomelo segments are bigger than orange ones.
tip: Chinese grapefruit 一般指 pomelo; grapefruit 是西柚。

ex: Mulberry leaves feed silkworms.
tip: mulberry bush 桑树; mulberry street 桑树街(美国童话)。

ex: Blackcurrant juice is rich in vitamin C.
tip: 英式高频水果;许多糖果用此味。

ex: Gooseberries grow on thorny bushes.
ex_zh: 醋栗长在带刺的灌木上。
tip: gooseberry 也作 '电灯泡' 俚语。

ex: A nectarine is like a smooth-skinned peach.
tip: nectar 神酒 / 花蜜;nectarine 即无毛桃。

ex: Quince paste is traditional with cheese.
tip: 希腊神话 Paris 裁判苹果之争,被认作 quince。

ex: Ripe jackfruit has a sweet, custard-like flavor.
ex_zh: 熟菠萝蜜味道像奶油甜点。
tip: 世界上最大水果; jackfruit seeds 菠萝蜜籽。

ex: Add raisins to the oatmeal for sweetness.
ex_zh: 在燕麦粥里加葡萄干提甜。
tip: currant 小葡萄干; sultana 无籽葡萄干(英)。

ex: Prunes are good for digestion.
tip: prune 原义 '修剪',后指干李子; 新鲜西梅是 plum。

ex: Fruit salad is a refreshing summer dessert.
ex_zh: 水果沙拉是清爽的夏日甜点。
tip: salad 一般指凉拌;fruit salad 甜咸皆可。

ex: Mango smoothie is my favorite summer drink.
ex_zh: 芒果冰沙是我最爱的夏日饮品。
tip: 与 milkshake 区别:smoothie 含水果不打奶昔。

ex: Orange juice contains lots of vitamin C.
tip: fresh-squeezed juice 鲜榨果汁。

ex: Hot apple cider warms you on a cold day.
tip: 美式 hard cider 含酒精;fresh cider 不含。

ex: Seedless grapes are easy to snack on.
tip: -less 后缀表示 '无'。

ex: Pick the tomatoes when they are fully ripe.
tip: ripen v. 成熟;overripe 过熟的。

ex: An unripe banana is hard to digest.
tip: un- 前缀表 '不' / '未';green 也表示未熟。

ex: Buy fresh fruit rather than canned.
tip: fresh fruit / fruit fresh,用法灵活。

ex: Frozen berries are great in smoothies.
tip: freeze v. 冷冻; frozen 已冷冻。

ex: Dried apricots make a great trail snack.
tip: dry v. / adj. 干;dried adj. 干燥的。

ex: Organic produce often costs more.
tip: organic fruit 有机水果;organic farm 有机农场。

ex: Seasonal fruits taste the freshest.
tip: in season 时令;out of season 反季。

ex: Pineapple and mango are tropical fruits.
ex_zh: 菠萝和芒果是热带水果。
tip: Tropic of Capricorn 南回归线;tropical climate 热带气候。

ex: Lemons and oranges both belong to the citrus family.
ex_zh: 柠檬和橙子都属于柑橘类。
tip: citrus 兼作名词 / 形容词。

ex: Don't forget to wash the apple peel.
tip: peel v. 削皮; potato peel 土豆皮。

ex: Slice the lemon for tea.
tip: slice 作名词 / 动词同形。

ex: Remove the core before slicing the apple.
tip: core 也表示 '核心',抽象意义。

ex: Cut the watermelon and remove the seeds.
tip: seedless 无籽的;seed 作动词 '播种'。

ex: Blend the fruit until smooth and pulpy.
ex_zh: 把水果打成光滑的果浆。
tip: wood pulp 木浆; orange pulp 橙肉。

ex: Serve the melon in small wedges.
ex_zh: 把瓜切成小楔形块端上。
tip: 柠檬常切 wedge 配饮料。

ex: Throw away the overripe bananas.
tip: over-(过度)+ ripe;

ex: Canned peaches are easy to store.
tip: can n. / v. 罐头 / 装罐。

ex: Grate lemon zest over the cake batter.
ex_zh: 在蛋糕糊上撒柠檬皮丝。
tip: zest 也指 '热情', 如 enthusiasm / zest for life。

ex: Top frozen yogurt with fresh berries.
ex_zh: 在冻酸奶上放新鲜莓果。
tip: 与冰淇淋区别:frozen yogurt 用酸奶,更酸。

ex: A warm peach cobbler is perfect for fall.
ex_zh: 温热的桃子酥皮派最适合秋天。
tip: cobbler 美国南方传统甜点。

ex: Serve the duck with a side of cherry compote.
tip: compote 法语词,糖水煮水果。

ex: Peaches and plums are stone fruits.
tip: 核果:果肉包着坚硬果核的水果。

ex: Berries are rich in antioxidants.
tip: banana 等其实不是严格意义的 berry; strawberry 也不是。

ex: The juice is sweet with a slightly tangy finish.
ex_zh: 这果汁甜中带着一点酸。
tip: tang n. 强烈味道;tangy adj. 酸爽的。

ex: This mango is wonderfully sweet.
tip: sweet 还可作名词 (糖果);sour 酸的对照。

ex: Lemons are sour but useful for cooking.
tip: sour 也可作动词 '使酸化'。

ex: The whole family gathered on the sofa to watch a movie.
ex_zh: 全家人聚在沙发上看电影。
tip: couch 是 sofa 的同义词,口语常用。

ex: He stretched out on the couch for a nap.
tip: couch potato 沙发土豆(成天看电视的人)。

ex: Grandma reads in her favorite armchair by the window.
ex_zh: 奶奶在她最爱的窗边扶手椅里读书。
tip: arm 扶手; chair 椅子。

ex: He sleeps in his recliner every night.
tip: recline v. 后仰; recliner 与 armchair 比可调角度。

ex: There are magazines spread on the coffee table.
tip: coffee table book 大开本画册。

ex: The bookshelf is filled with novels.
tip: shelf 架;复数 shelves。

ex: A tall bookcase stands against the wall.
tip: bookshelf 可指单层书架;bookcase 指整体柜子。

ex: The keys are in the cabinet by the door.
tip: kitchen cabinet 厨房橱柜;China cabinet 瓷器柜。

ex: Keep the remote control in the side drawer.
ex_zh: 把遥控器放在侧抽屉里。
tip: chest of drawers 五斗橱。

ex: Put the framed photo on the top shelf.
ex_zh: 把相框放到顶层架子上。
tip: bookshelf 书架; top shelf 顶层。

ex: The TV stand also has drawers for cables.
ex_zh: 电视柜还有抽屉放线缆。
tip: TV + stand,搭配记忆。

ex: Turn off the TV before dinner.
tip: TV = television 缩写。

ex: Where did I leave the remote control again?
tip: 常用 remote 一词简写,口语高频。

ex: Bluetooth speakers fill the room with music.
ex_zh: 蓝牙音箱让房间充满音乐。
tip: loudspeaker 扬声器;bookshelf speaker 书架箱。

ex: A soundbar improves the TV sound without many wires.
ex_zh: 回音壁用很少的线材就能提升电视声音。
tip: soundbar 弥补电视自带扬声器音质。

ex: She turned on the reading lamp next to the sofa.
ex_zh: 她打开沙发旁的阅读灯。
tip: table lamp 台灯; floor lamp 落地灯。

ex: A tall floor lamp lights up the reading corner.
ex_zh: 一盏高高的落地灯照亮阅读角。
tip: floor 地面; lamp 灯。

ex: The ceiling light casts a soft glow over the room.
ex_zh: 吸顶灯给房间投下柔和光。
tip: ceiling 天花板;light 灯。

ex: Draw the curtains at dusk for privacy.
ex_zh: 黄昏时拉上窗帘保护隐私。
tip: curtain 偏装饰;blind 百叶窗。

ex: Roller blinds block the harsh afternoon sun.
ex_zh: 卷帘挡住午后刺眼的阳光。
tip: Venetian blind 威尼斯百叶。

ex: A cozy rug softens the wooden floor.
ex_zh: 小地毯让木地板更柔和。
tip: carpet 通常指大块地毯;rug 指小块的。

ex: The carpet covers most of the living room floor.
ex_zh: 地毯覆盖了客厅的大部分地板。
tip: carpet 偏全屋铺设。

ex: She arranged the cushions on the sofa.
ex_zh: 她把靠垫在沙发上摆好。
tip: cushion 还可指 '缓冲物'。

ex: A small pillow supports my lower back.
tip: pillow fight 枕头大战。

ex: A throw blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex_zh: 凉夜里沙发毯让我不冷。
tip: throw v. 披;blanket 毯。

ex: A glass vase on the table holds fresh tulips.
ex_zh: 桌上的玻璃花瓶插着新鲜郁金香。
tip: vase 不可数时指 '花瓶';可数指 '一件花瓶'。

ex: Family photos sit in silver photo frames on the mantel.
ex_zh: 壁炉台上的银色相框里摆着家庭照片。
tip: framed artwork 装框艺术品。

ex: A landscape painting hangs above the sofa.
ex_zh: 沙发上挂着一幅风景油画。
tip: painting 比 picture 更正式,可指任何绘画。

ex: The wall clock ticks softly in the background.
ex_zh: 挂钟在背景里轻轻滴答。
tip: analog clock 指针式;digital clock 数字式。

ex: Set the alarm clock for six tomorrow morning.
ex_zh: 把闹钟调到明早 6 点。
tip: alarm 警报;alarm clock 仅指闹钟。

ex: She checked her reflection in the mirror near the door.
ex_zh: 她在门边的镜子里照了照。
tip: mirror 也是动词 '反映'。

ex: The magazine rack by the sofa holds today's papers.
ex_zh: 沙发旁的杂志架放着今天的报纸。
tip: rack 架;magazine 杂志。

ex: After a long day, I prop my feet on the footstool.
ex_zh: 忙了一天我把脚搁在脚凳上。
tip: foot + stool = 脚凳。

ex: The ottoman opens for extra blankets.
ex_zh: 软垫凳可打开存放备用毯。
tip: ottoman 原指奥斯曼帝国。

ex: Heavy stone bookends keep the books upright.
tip: end 端,book ends 书的端部挡具。

ex: Wipe your feet on the doormat before coming in.
ex_zh: 进来前先在门垫上蹭蹭脚。
tip: doormat 也指 '受气包' 俚语。

ex: Turn on the air conditioner; it is too hot.
tip: AC 缩写常见;空调的制冷制热功能。

ex: The portable heater warms up the bedroom quickly.
ex_zh: 便携式取暖器让卧室迅速变暖。
tip: central heating 中央供暖;space heater 移动式。

ex: The ceiling fan spins slowly above the dining table.
ex_zh: 吊扇在餐桌上方慢慢转。
tip: ceiling fan 吊扇;stand fan 落地扇。

ex: Run the humidifier at night in winter.
tip: dehumidifier 除湿器,反义前缀 de-。

ex: The candle gives the room a warm glow.
ex_zh: 蜡烛给房间带来温暖的光。
tip: candlelight dinner 烛光晚餐。

ex: Pass the tissue box; I need to blow my nose.
ex_zh: 把纸巾盒递给我,我擤下鼻涕。
tip: tissue 既可作 '纸巾' 也作 '组织'。

ex: Throw the wrapper into the trash can.
tip: 美式 trash can; 英式常用 rubbish bin。

ex: Glass bottles go into the recycling bin.
tip: recycle v. 回收; recycling n. 回收利用。

ex: I forgot the phone charger at the hotel.
ex_zh: 我把手机充电器落在酒店了。
tip: phone charger; wire 充电线。

ex: Plug the TV into the power strip behind the stand.
ex_zh: 把电视插到电视柜后面的插线板上。
tip: power strip 美式;power bar / extension block 英式。

ex: Restart the WiFi router if the connection drops.
tip: WiFi + router; 与 modem 调制解调器区分。

ex: The doorbell rang twice before she opened.
ex_zh: 门铃响了两下她才开门。
tip: doorbell intercom 门铃对讲机。

ex: Hang your keys on the wall key holder.
ex_zh: 把钥匙挂到墙上的钥匙挂上。
tip: key cabinet 钥匙柜。

ex: Shoes must go into the shoe cabinet before entering.
ex_zh: 进门前必须把鞋放进鞋柜。
tip: shoe rack 鞋架; cabinet 柜。

ex: A small console table holds keys and mail.
ex_zh: 一张小玄关桌放着钥匙和信件。
tip: console 控制台;这里指窄长桌。

ex: The monstera is thriving in its new plant pot.
ex_zh: 龟背竹在新花盆里长势喜人。
tip: flower pot 也行;planter 多肉陶罐。

ex: A row of succulents lines the windowsill.
ex_zh: 一排多肉植物摆在窗台上。
tip: succulent 也可指 '多汁的'(肉) juicy。

ex: Run the diffuser for a calm atmosphere.
ex_zh: 开香薰机营造平静氛围。
tip: diffuse v. 扩散; aroma diffuser 香薰器。

ex: She burns incense for ten minutes before yoga.
ex_zh: 瑜伽前她点 10 分钟的香。
tip: incense stick 线香。

ex: An area rug defines the seating zone in the open plan.
ex_zh: 区块地毯在开放式户型里划分出休闲区。
tip: area + rug,空间分区必备。

ex: She switches on the reading lamp as the sun goes down.
ex_zh: 太阳下山时她打开阅读灯。
tip: reading lamp 比 desk lamp 装饰性更强。

ex: Ask the smart speaker to play your favorite playlist.
ex_zh: 让智能音箱播放你最喜欢的歌单。
tip: smart + speaker; Alexa / Google Home 之类。

ex: Screw the shelf brackets into the wall studs.
ex_zh: 把搁板支架拧进墙骨里。
tip: bracket 支架 / 括号。

ex: Hang the jacket on the clothes hanger.
tip: hanger 衣架; hook 挂钩。

ex: The herbs grow well in this self-watering planter.
ex_zh: 香草在这个自动浇水花盆里长得很好。
tip: planter 通常比 flower pot 更大,可落地;

ex: Don't forget to use coasters under your drinks.
tip: coaster 单数;a set of coasters 一套杯垫。

ex: Open the window for some fresh air.
tip: bay window 凸窗; French window 落地窗。

ex: Turn the doorknob slowly so the baby doesn't wake.
ex_zh: 慢慢转门把,免得吵醒宝宝。
tip: doorknob 美式;英式常用 door handle。

ex: The decor is minimalist but warm.
tip: decor = decoration 缩写;home decor 家装。

ex: A rug pad keeps the rug from sliding.
ex_zh: 地毯防滑垫防止地毯滑动。
tip: pad 垫,用途很广;cushion 也是垫。

ex: Switch out wall art seasonally for a fresh look.
ex_zh: 按季换墙艺让家有新鲜感。
tip: art 艺术;wall art 包含画、装饰品。

ex: The entryway should be tidy before guests arrive.
ex_zh: 客人来之前玄关要整洁。
tip: entry 入场 + way 路; foyer 也是玄关。

ex: She changes the pillowcases once a week.
tip: pillowcase = pillow + case(套子)。

ex: He pulled a soft blanket over his legs.
ex_zh: 他把一条柔软的毯子盖到腿上。
tip: electric blanket 电热毯。

ex: Swap the cushion covers with the seasons.
tip: slipcover 沙发套;cushion cover 与 pillowcase 类似结构。

ex: A ceiling fan with light keeps the room cool and bright.
ex_zh: 带灯吊扇让房间又凉又亮。
tip: combo 词组,功能组合。

ex: She arranged a bouquet of roses on the table.
ex_zh: 她在桌上摆了一束玫瑰。
tip: 注意发音 /buˈkeɪ/;

ex: She flips through a fashion magazine on the sofa.
ex_zh: 她在沙发上翻时尚杂志。
tip: 与 newspaper 区别:杂志定期出版,报纸不固定。

ex: He reads the morning newspaper with coffee.
tip: daily newspaper 日报; tabloid 小报。

ex: Board games are great for family nights.
ex_zh: 家庭之夜玩桌游最开心。
tip: boardgame 是休闲必备; chess 棋类。

ex: The video game console connects to the big TV.
ex_zh: 游戏主机接在大电视上。
tip: PlayStation / Xbox / Nintendo Switch 都是 gaming console。

ex: The subwoofer makes explosions shake the couch.
ex_zh: 低音炮让爆炸声震得沙发发颤。
tip: sub- 前缀表示 '次 / 之下'; woofer 低音单元。

ex: Move the router to the center of the apartment.
ex_zh: 把路由器挪到公寓正中。
tip: router 也指木工开槽机。

ex: A recliner sofa is perfect for movie nights.
ex_zh: 躺椅沙发看电影的体验很棒。
tip: recliner + sofa 复合词,功能组合。

ex: Dice two tomatoes for the salad.
ex_zh: 把两个番茄切丁做沙拉。
tip: cherry tomato 圣女果;tomato paste 番茄酱。

ex: Boil the potatoes until they are soft.
tip: sweet potato 红薯(不同种);mashed potato 土豆泥。

ex: Slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
tip: sea cucumber 海参(不同物)。

ex: Grate the carrot for the slaw.
ex_zh: 把胡萝卜擦丝做凉拌菜。
tip: carrot cake 胡萝卜蛋糕;baby carrot 小胡萝卜。

ex: Shred the cabbage finely for the slaw.
ex_zh: 把卷心菜切细丝做沙拉。
tip: Chinese cabbage 大白菜;red cabbage 紫甘蓝。

ex: Add fresh spinach to the pasta at the end.
ex_zh: 最后把新鲜菠菜加到意面里。
tip: baby spinach 嫩菠菜;spinach dip 菠菜蘸酱。

ex: Steam the broccoli for five minutes.
tip: 与 cauliflower 形似,颜色不同(绿 vs 白)。

ex: Roast the cauliflower with olive oil.
tip: 白色的 cauliflower,绿色的 broccoli。

ex: Grill the eggplant slices until tender.
tip: 英式叫 aubergine;北美常用 eggplant。

ex: We carve pumpkins for Halloween.
tip: pumpkin pie 南瓜派;squash 是近亲。

ex: Chop one onion and sauté until golden.
tip: green onion / scallion 葱;red onion 紫洋葱。

ex: Crush two cloves of garlic.
tip: a clove of garlic 一瓣蒜;garlic bread 蒜香面包。

ex: Grate some ginger into the soup.
tip: ginger tea 姜茶;ginger ale 姜汁汽水。

ex: Sprinkle chopped scallions on top.
tip: 也叫 green onion;spring onion 英式。

ex: Slice the leek and rinse well.
tip: leek 比 scallion 粗壮,常用于炖汤。

ex: Celery adds crunch to the salad.
tip: celery stick 芹菜条;celery salt 芹盐。

ex: Wash the lettuce and tear the leaves.
tip: romaine lettuce 罗马生菜;iceberg 结球生菜。

ex: Thinly slice the radishes for garnish.
ex_zh: 把小萝卜切薄片做装饰。
tip: daikon radish 白萝卜(日式)。

ex: Roast the turnips with carrots and potatoes.
ex_zh: 把芜菁和胡萝卜土豆一起烤。
tip: turnip 与 rutabaga 近亲但更小。

ex: Beetroot gives the salad a deep red color.
ex_zh: 甜菜根让沙拉呈深红色。
tip: 美式叫 beet;pickled beetroot 腌甜菜。

ex: Slice the zucchini lengthwise for grilling.
ex_zh: 把西葫芦纵向切片好烤。
tip: 英式叫 courgette;zucchini noodles 西葫芦面。

ex: Use red bell pepper for a sweeter taste.
tip: 红黄绿三色;capsicum 澳洲叫法。

ex: Add one chili pepper if you like it spicy.
tip: chili flakes 辣椒碎;chili powder 辣椒粉。

ex: Trim the ends off the green beans.
tip: snap pea 甜脆豆;snow pea 荷兰豆。

ex: Add frozen peas to the fried rice.
ex_zh: 把冷冻豌豆加到炒饭里。
tip: green peas 青豆;split pea soup 豌豆汤。

ex: Grill the corn with butter.
tip: corn on the cob 整根玉米;sweet corn 甜玉米。

ex: Sauté the mushrooms until browned.
tip: shiitake 香菇;button mushroom 口蘑。

ex: Blanch the asparagus for two minutes.
tip: 四季都有但春季最嫩。

ex: Steam the artichoke and dip the leaves.
tip: Jerusalem artichoke 洋姜(不同物)。

ex: Add bean sprouts to the stir-fry.
tip: soybean sprout 黄豆芽;mung bean sprout 绿豆芽。

ex: Bamboo shoots add crunch to the stir-fry.
tip: 常见于亚洲菜肴。

ex: Bitter melon is good for blood sugar.
tip: bitter gourd 同义;中式常炒蛋。

ex: Winter melon soup is light and clear.
tip: winter melon tea 冬瓜茶(台式饮品)。

ex: Grill the okra to reduce the sliminess.
tip: 也叫 lady's finger(印度英语)。

ex: Bake the sweet potato until soft.
tip: 与 potato 不同科;sweet potato fries 红薯条。

ex: Steam the taro and mash it for dessert.
tip: taro bubble tea 芋头奶茶。

ex: Slice the lotus root thinly for the soup.
tip: 横切有漂亮孔洞图案。

ex: Chinese cabbage is great in hot pot.
tip: napa cabbage 同义;bok choy 是小白菜。

ex: Stir-fry the bok choy with garlic.
tip: baby bok choy 小油菜。

ex: Massage the kale with olive oil for the salad.
ex_zh: 用橄榄油揉搓羽衣甘蓝做沙拉。
tip: superfood 代表; kale chips 羽衣脆片。

ex: Arugula adds a peppery flavor.
ex_zh: 芝麻菜增添胡椒般的风味。
tip: 英式叫 rocket;常用于意式沙拉。

ex: Garnish with chopped parsley.
tip: flat-leaf parsley 平叶欧芹;curly 卷叶。

ex: Sprinkle cilantro over the tacos.
tip: 英式叫 coriander;有人尝出肥皂味(基因)。

ex: Tear the basil leaves onto the pizza.
tip: Thai basil 打抛叶(泰餐);pesto 青酱主料。

ex: Add mint leaves to the iced tea.
tip: peppermint 胡椒薄荷;spearmint 留兰香。

ex: Dice the onion into small cubes.
tip: 刀工四件套:dice 丁/slice 片/chop 剁/mince 末。

ex: Slice the cucumber very thinly.
tip: slice 也可作名词 '一片'。

ex: Chop the parsley roughly.
tip: chop 力度比 slice 大。

ex: Stir-fry the greens over high heat.
tip: stir 搅动 + fry 煎炸;wok hei 锅气。

ex: Blanch the greens for thirty seconds.
tip: blanch = 快速煮后立即过冷水。

ex: I drive my car to work every morning.
tip: car pool 拼车;rental car 租车。

ex: The bus arrives every fifteen minutes.
ex_zh: 公交车每 15 分钟一班。
tip: bus stop 公交站;shuttle bus 班车。

ex: We took the train to Munich yesterday.
ex_zh: 我们昨天坐火车去慕尼黑。
tip: high-speed rail 高铁;local train 慢车。

ex: The subway is the fastest way downtown.
ex_zh: 地铁是去市中心最快的方式。
tip: 英式 underground / tube;metro 通用。

ex: Let's take a taxi since it's raining.
tip: cab 同义;hail a taxi 招手打车。

ex: He rides his bicycle to the office.
tip: bike 口语;bike lane 自行车道。

ex: A motorcycle is faster in heavy traffic.
tip: motorbike 英式;scooter 小踏板。

ex: The airplane departs at eight tonight.
tip: plane 口语;boarding 登机。

ex: We took the ferry across the river.
tip: ferry terminal 渡轮码头。

ex: Meet me at the train station at six.
tip: bus station 汽车站;railway station 火车站。

ex: The airport is forty minutes from here.
tip: air + port(港);airport shuttle 机场大巴。

ex: The train leaves from platform three.
ex_zh: 火车从 3 号站台发车。
tip: platform ticket 站台票(部分国家)。

ex: I bought a ticket online this morning.
tip: round-trip ticket 往返票;one-way 单程。

ex: The bus fare is two euros.
tip: taxi fare 出租车费;half fare 半价。

ex: Check the schedule before you leave.
tip: timetable 英式;schedule 美式更泛。

ex: The traffic was terrible this morning.
tip: traffic jam 堵车;heavy traffic 拥堵。

ex: Avoid driving during rush hour.
tip: morning/evening rush hour 早晚高峰。

ex: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
tip: bumper-to-bumper 车挨着车(形容堵)。

ex: Take the highway and exit at Exit 5.
tip: motorway 英式;freeway 美式西部。

ex: Turn left at the next intersection.
tip: crossroads 同义;junction 英式。

ex: Use the crosswalk to cross the street.
tip: zebra crossing 斑马线(英式)。

ex: Park the car along the sidewalk.
tip: pavement 英式;pedestrian 行人。

ex: The parking lot is full; try level two.
tip: car park 英式;parking space 车位。

ex: We need to stop for fuel soon.
tip: gas 美式口语;petrol 英式。

ex: There is a gas station around the corner.
tip: petrol station 英式;filling station 也行。

ex: Our driver will meet you at the exit.
ex_zh: 我们的司机会在出口接你。
tip: drive v. 驾驶;driver's license 驾照。

ex: All passengers must wear seat belts.
ex_zh: 所有乘客必须系安全带。
tip: 比较 passenger / driver / pedestrian。

ex: Please fasten your seat belt.
tip: buckle up 系安全带(口语)。

ex: Stop at the traffic light ahead.
tip: traffic signal 同义;run a red light 闯红灯。

ex: My daily commute takes about forty minutes.
ex_zh: 我每天通勤约 40 分钟。
tip: commute n./v. 通勤;commuter 通勤者。

ex: Our departure is scheduled for noon.
tip: depart v. 离开;departure board 航班屏。

ex: What is your estimated arrival time?
tip: arrive v. 到达;arrivals hall 到达大厅。

ex: The flight has a two-hour delay.
tip: delayed adj. 被延误的。

ex: Please show your boarding pass and passport.
tip: boarding gate 登机口;boarding time 登机时间。

ex: Check your luggage at the counter.
tip: baggage 美式同义;carry-on 随身行李。

ex: We cleared customs in twenty minutes.
ex_zh: 我们 20 分钟过了海关。
tip: customs declaration 海关申报;custom 习俗(不同义)。

ex: Don't forget your passport at the hotel.
tip: pass(通过)+ port(港)。

ex: Which terminal does the flight depart from?
ex_zh: 这班飞机从哪个航站楼出发?
tip: Terminal 1/2/3;terminal 也指 '终点'。

ex: We have a one-hour transfer in Frankfurt.
ex_zh: 我们在法兰克福有 1 小时转机。
tip: layover 美式同义;transfer n./v.。

ex: A round trip ticket is usually cheaper.
tip: return ticket 英式;one way 单程。

ex: What is your final destination?
ex_zh: 您的最终目的地是哪里?
tip: destine v. 注定;destination 目的地。

ex: Which route do you usually take home?
tip: detour 绕行;take a different route 换路。

ex: The navigation says turn right ahead.
tip: GPS navigation 卫星导航;navigate v.。

ex: We had to take a detour due to roadwork.
ex_zh: 因修路我们不得不绕道。
tip: de-(离开)+ tour(路线)。

ex: Watch out for pedestrians crossing here.
ex_zh: 注意这里过马路的行人。
tip: pedestrian zone 步行区;pedestrian bridge 天桥。

ex: The ticket office closes at eight tonight.
ex_zh: 售票处今晚 8 点关门。
tip: ticket counter / booking office 也常见。

ex: Do I need a seat reservation?
tip: reserve v. 预订;reservation n. 预订。

ex: Take the express train to save time.
tip: express 快;local 慢(站站停)。

ex: I get off at the next stop.
tip: get on 上车;get off 下车;get in/out 小车。

ex: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
ex_zh: 打扰一下,请问车站怎么走?
tip: 问路万能句,比 Where is... 更自然。

ex: I usually shop at the corner store.
ex_zh: 我通常在街角那家店买东西。
tip: shop v. 购物 / n. 商店;shopping n. 购物。

ex: The store opens at nine every morning.
ex_zh: 这家店每天早 9 点开门。
tip: store 美式;shop 英式更常用。

ex: Let's meet at the mall this weekend.
tip: shopping mall / shopping centre 全称。

ex: I buy groceries at the supermarket every Sunday.
tip: grocery store 也常见;hypermarket 大卖场。

ex: The cashier scanned all the items quickly.
ex_zh: 收银员快速扫完所有商品。
tip: cash n. 现金;cashier 收银员。

ex: Please proceed to the checkout counter.
tip: check out v. 结账离开(酒店也用)。

ex: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
tip: 注意 p 不发音 /rɪˈsiːt/。

ex: I filled the shopping cart with vegetables.
ex_zh: 我把购物车装满了蔬菜。
tip: basket 手提篮;trolley 英式推车。

ex: What is the price of this jacket?
tip: price tag 价签;pricing 定价。

ex: Do you offer a student discount?
tip: 10% discount 打九折;discount code 折扣码。

ex: These shoes are on sale this week.
tip: for sale 出售中;on sale 打折中——别混。

ex: I have a coupon for ten percent off.
tip: voucher 英式;coupon code 优惠码。

ex: Can I get a refund for this item?
tip: re-(回)+ fund(资金);refund n./v.。

ex: I'd like to exchange this for a larger size.
tip: exchange A for B 把 A 换成 B。

ex: You can return it within thirty days.
tip: return policy 退货政策。

ex: I want to buy a birthday gift for my wife.
ex_zh: 我想给妻子买个生日礼物。
tip: buy - bought - bought 不规则变化。

ex: They sell fresh bread every morning.
ex_zh: 他们每天早上卖新鲜面包。
tip: sell - sold - sold;sale 是名词。

ex: Can I pay by card or in cash?
ex_zh: 我可以刷卡还是付现金?
tip: pay - paid - paid;payment n. 付款。

ex: How much does this cost?
tip: cost n./v.;How much 提问价格。

ex: Keep the change, please.
tip: change 也指 '改变';这里是 '找回的钱'。

ex: Sorry, we only accept cash today.
tip: pay in cash 付现金;cash-only 只收现金。

ex: I put it on my credit card.
tip: debit card 借记卡;card machine 刷卡机。

ex: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
ex_zh: 那家餐厅对我们来说太贵了。
tip: pricey 口语同义;cheap 反义。

ex: This one is cheap but good quality.
tip: cheap 有时带贬义 '劣质'; affordable 更中性。

ex: We found an affordable apartment downtown.
ex_zh: 我们在市中心找到一套负担得起的公寓。
tip: afford v. 负担得起 + -able。

ex: That jacket was a real bargain.
ex_zh: 那件外套真是捡到便宜了。
tip: bargain v. 讨价还价 / n. 便宜货。

ex: Do you have this in a medium size?
tip: S/M/L尺码;run large/small 偏大/小。

ex: The fitting rooms are over there.
tip: try on 试穿;fitting n. 试穿。

ex: Can I try on these shoes?
tip: try it on 代词放中间。

ex: Which brand do you usually buy?
tip: brand name 品牌名;off-brand 杂牌。

ex: The quality is excellent for the price.
ex_zh: 就这价格来说质量很好。
tip: high/low quality;quality control 质检。

ex: It comes with a two-year warranty.
tip: guarantee 担保;warranty period 保修期。

ex: The customer asked for a smaller size.
ex_zh: 那位顾客要了更小的号。
tip: client 更正式;customer service 客服。

ex: Check the shopping list before we go.
tip: make a list 列清单;to-do list 待办。

ex: Sorry, that flavor is sold out.
tip: sell out 售罄;sold out 形容词状态。

ex: Is this model in stock right now?
tip: out of stock 缺货;stock n. 库存。

ex: Compare the prices before you decide.
tip: comparison n. 比较;compare A with B。

ex: That is over my monthly budget.
tip: on a tight budget 预算紧张;budget-friendly 实惠。

ex: Buying in bulk can save money.
tip: save up 存钱;cost-saving 省钱的。

ex: Contact customer service if it breaks.
tip: after-sales service 售后服务(更正式)。

ex: Pay at the counter near the entrance.
ex_zh: 在入口附近的柜台付款。
tip: service counter 服务台;ticket counter 售票处。

ex: Canned goods are in aisle four.
tip: 注意 s 不发音 /aɪl/。

ex: Read the label for the ingredients.
tip: brand label 品牌标;price label 价签。

ex: The packaging was damaged in transit.
tip: package n. 包裹;pack v. 打包。

ex: Orders over fifty euros get free shipping.
tip: shipping fee 运费;delivery charge 配送费。

ex: Delivery takes two to three days.
tip: deliver v. 递送;delivery date 送达日。

ex: I placed an order online last night.
tip: place an order 下单;cancel an order 取消订单。

ex: Online shopping saves me a lot of time.
ex_zh: 网购给我省了很多时间。
tip: online + shopping;e-commerce 电商。

ex: Show your membership card for extra points.
tip: member 成员;membership 会员资格。

ex: You can redeem loyalty points for discounts.
tip: redeem v. 兑换;point system 积分制。

ex: Regular exercise is good for your health.
tip: healthy adj. 健康的;health care 医疗。

ex: I have an appointment with the doctor at three.
ex_zh: 我约了医生 3 点见面。
tip: physician 内科医生;Dr. 缩写。

ex: The nurse took my temperature.
tip: nursing n. 护理;head nurse 护士长。

ex: He was taken to the hospital last night.
tip: go to hospital 英式(无 the);美式加 the。

ex: There is a walk-in clinic nearby.
ex_zh: 附近有家不用预约的诊所。
tip: clinic 小规模;hospital 大型综合。

ex: The pharmacy is open until ten tonight.
ex_zh: 药店营业到今晚 10 点。
tip: drugstore 美式;chemist 英式。

ex: Take this medicine twice a day.
tip: medication 更正式;take medicine 服药(不用 eat)。

ex: The doctor prescribed a sleeping pill.
tip: tablet 药片;capsule 胶囊。

ex: You need a prescription for this drug.
tip: prescribe v. 开处方;OTC 非处方药。

ex: What are your symptoms exactly?
tip: symptom vs sign(体征,医生观察到)。

ex: The child has a high fever tonight.
tip: have a fever 发烧;temperature 体温。

ex: I have a terrible headache after work.
tip: head + ache;migraine 偏头痛。

ex: He has had a bad cough for a week.
tip: cough syrup 止咳糖浆;cough n./v.。

ex: I caught a cold after the flight.
tip: catch a cold 感冒;have a cold 正在感冒。

ex: She stayed home with the flu yesterday.
ex_zh: 她昨天得流感在家休息。
tip: influenza 全称;flu shot 流感疫苗。

ex: Where exactly is the pain?
tip: painful adj. 疼痛的;no pain no gain 谚语。

ex: I have a sore throat and can barely speak.
ex_zh: 我喉咙痛几乎说不出话。
tip: sore adj. 酸痛的;sore muscles 肌肉酸痛。

ex: He got a stomachache after lunch.
tip: stomach + ache;类似 toothache / headache。

ex: The injury kept him out for two weeks.
tip: injure v. 使受伤;wound 多指外伤伤口。

ex: Let me check your blood pressure first.
tip: high/low blood pressure 高血压/低血压。

ex: I go for a yearly checkup every spring.
ex_zh: 我每年春天做一次体检。
tip: health checkup 体检;physical exam 体格检查。

ex: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Lee.
tip: make/ book an appointment 预约;app 缩写。

ex: Does your insurance cover this treatment?
ex_zh: 您的保险覆盖这项治疗吗?
tip: health insurance 医保;insure v. 投保。

ex: Call this number in case of emergency.
tip: emergency room (ER) 急诊室;emergent adj.。

ex: Call an ambulance right now!
tip: ambulance siren 救护车的警笛。

ex: I have a seafood allergy, so no shrimp.
tip: allergic to... 对……过敏;allergen 过敏原。

ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
tip: infect v. 感染;infectious adj. 传染的。

ex: Have you had your flu vaccine this year?
ex_zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了吗?
tip: vaccination n. 接种;get vaccinated 接种疫苗。

ex: The surgery is scheduled for next Tuesday.
tip: surgeon 外科医生;operate v. 动手术。

ex: It took him a month to recover fully.
ex_zh: 他花了一个月才完全康复。
tip: recovery n. 康复;recover from... 从……恢复。

ex: Get plenty of rest and drink water.
tip: take a rest 休息一下;rest area 休息区。

ex: Daily exercise keeps me energetic.
ex_zh: 每天运动让我精力充沛。
tip: work out 口语 '健身';exercise n./v.。

ex: A balanced diet is key to good health.
ex_zh: 均衡饮食是健康的关键。
tip: be on a diet 正在节食;dietitian 营养师。

ex: This cereal is full of good nutrition.
tip: nutrition facts 营养成分表;nutritious adj.。

ex: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
tip: vitamin D / B12;multivitamin 复合维生素。

ex: I need eight hours of sleep to function.
ex_zh: 我需要 8 小时睡眠才有精神。
tip: sleepy adj. 困的;asleep adj. 睡着的。

ex: Work stress has been affecting my sleep.
ex_zh: 工作压力影响了我的睡眠。
tip: stressed adj. 有压力的;stress management 压力管理。

ex: Mental health is as important as physical health.
ex_zh: 心理健康和身体健康同样重要。
tip: mental adj. 心智的;well-being 幸福感。

ex: He started physical therapy after the injury.
ex_zh: 他受伤后开始做物理治疗。
tip: therapist 治疗师;physiotherapy 理疗(英式)。

ex: The doctor ordered an X-ray of my chest.
ex_zh: 医生让我拍胸部 X 光。
tip: CT scan / MRI 更高级影像检查。

ex: This drug may cause drowsiness as a side effect.
ex_zh: 这药可能有嗜睡的副作用。
tip: side effect 复数 side effects。

ex: Follow the dosage on the label carefully.
ex_zh: 仔细按标签上的剂量服用。
tip: dose n. 一剂;overdose 过量服用。

ex: Try to eat healthy food every day.
tip: health n. → healthy adj.;unhealthy 不健康。

ex: Put a bandage on the cut to stop bleeding.
ex_zh: 在伤口上贴创可贴止血。
tip: Band-Aid 邦迪(品牌名演变为通用词)。

ex: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.
tip: dizziness n. 眩晕;light-headed 类似。

ex: I felt nauseous after taking the medicine.
tip: nausea n. 恶心(/ˈnɔːziə/)。

ex: Antibiotics won't help against a virus.
tip: anti-(对抗)+biotic(生命);需处方。

ex: Sleep strengthens your immune system.
tip: immune adj. 免疫的;immunity n. 免疫力。

ex: He is on sick leave for three days.
tip: sick day 病假日;call in sick 打电话请病假。

ex: I hope you get better soon.
tip: 慰问病人万能句;get well soon 也能用。

ex: Hello, nice to see you again.
tip: 最通用问候;hi 更随意,hey 更熟。

ex: Goodbye, have a safe trip home.
tip: bye / see you / take care 都是变体。

ex: Thank you for your help with the report.
tip: thanks 更口语;thanks a lot / thank you so much 加强。

ex: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
ex_zh: 抱歉,我没听清您的名字。
tip: sorry 致歉;excuse me 是打扰前说。

ex: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
ex_zh: 打扰一下,这个座位有人吗?
tip: 引起注意/借过/离席都用它。

ex: Nice to meet you, I'm Wang Lei.
ex_zh: 很高兴认识您,我是王雷。
tip: 初次见面用;重逢用 nice to see you again。

ex: Hi Tom, how are you doing?
tip: 常等于 hello,不必真汇报身体状况。

ex: See you later at the meeting.
tip: see you soon / tomorrow 是变体。

ex: Welcome to our office in Shanghai.
ex_zh: 欢迎来到我们上海办公室。
tip: You're welcome 回答别人的感谢。

ex: Let me introduce you to my colleague Anna.
ex_zh: 让我把你介绍给我同事 Anna。
tip: introduction n. 介绍;self-introduction 自我介绍。

ex: We'd like to invite you to dinner Friday.
ex_zh: 我们想周五请你吃晚饭。
tip: invitation n. 邀请;invite sb to + 地点/活动。

ex: Thanks for the invitation to the workshop.
ex_zh: 感谢邀请我参加研讨会。
tip: wedding invitation 婚礼请柬。

ex: I apologize for the late reply.
tip: apology n. 道歉;apologize for (doing) sth。

ex: Congratulations on your promotion!
tip: 口语缩写成 congrats;on 后接具体事项。

ex: She complimented me on my presentation.
tip: compliment sb on sth 称赞某人某事。

ex: Let's grab a coffee and chat sometime.
ex_zh: 有空一起喝杯咖啡聊聊。
tip: have a chat 聊聊天;small talk 寒暄。

ex: Small talk about the weather is safe here.
ex_zh: 聊天气是很保险的寒暄。
tip: 西方社交必备,避免问收入年龄。

ex: Let's catch up over lunch next week.
tip: catch up on... 补课/补看;如 catch up on sleep。

ex: Keep in touch after you move to Berlin.
tip: stay in touch 同义;lose touch 失去联系。

ex: My colleague will join us in a minute.
tip: colleague 偏正式;coworker 偏口语。

ex: My neighbor watered my plants last week.
tip: neighborhood n. 社区;good fences make good neighbors 谚语。

ex: We have guests coming over tonight.
tip: host 主人接待 guest 客人。

ex: Who is hosting the meeting this Friday?
tip: host n./v. 主人/主持;hostess 女主人。

ex: There is a small party for him on Friday.
ex_zh: 周五有个为他办的小聚会。
tip: birthday party / office party / dinner party。

ex: Can I ask you a small favor?
tip: do sb a favor 帮某人;return a favor 还人情。

ex: Can I give you a piece of advice?
tip: advice 不可数;a piece of advice 一条建议。

ex: What is your opinion on this proposal?
tip: in my opinion 依我看;opinion n. 可数。

ex: I agree with you on this point.
tip: agree with sb / agree on sth;disagree 反义。

ex: It is polite to arrive on time here.
ex_zh: 这里准时到是有礼貌的表现。
tip: politeness n. 礼貌;impolite / rude 反义。

ex: It is rude to interrupt someone.
tip: rudeness n. 粗鲁;impolite 近义。

ex: Everyone here is friendly to newcomers.
ex_zh: 这里每个人都对新人友好。
tip: friend + ly;friendliness n. 友善。

ex: To be honest, I don't like that idea.
ex_zh: 说实话,我不喜欢那个主意。
tip: to be honest 常用插入语;honesty n. 诚实。

ex: Please be patient; the results take time.
ex_zh: 请耐心些,结果需要时间。
tip: patience n. 耐心;patient 也指 '病人'。

ex: He has a great sense of humor.
tip: humor n. 幽默;humorous adj. 幽默的。

ex: I brought a small gift for your daughter.
ex_zh: 我给你女儿带了份小礼物。
tip: present 同义;gift wrap 礼品包装。

ex: Happy birthday! Have a great one.
tip: birth + day;birthday card / cake / party。

ex: Hey Mark, how is it going?
tip: 熟人间的随意问候;等于 How are you doing。

ex: Take care, and see you next month.
tip: 美式常用道别语,带关心语气。

ex: Thanks for calling. Have a nice day!
tip: 服务业结束语;也用于一般道别。

ex: Thanks for the help, I really appreciate it.
tip: 比 thank you 更正式;appreciate v. 感激。

ex: No problem, happy to help anytime.
tip: 回答感谢;也可用 You're welcome / My pleasure。

ex: I'm doing well. How about you?
tip: 把话题抛回去,避免冷场。

ex: I couldn't agree more with that assessment.
tip: 高阶赞同表达,开会很有用。

ex: Long time no see! How have you been?
tip: 源自中式英语但已被主流接受。

ex: Do you need any help with the luggage?
tip: helpful adj. 有帮助的;helpless 无助的。

ex: I promise I'll send the file by noon.
ex_zh: 我保证中午前把文件发过去。
tip: promise to do / promise (that)...;keep a promise 守信。

ex: Their friendship goes back twenty years.
ex_zh: 他们的友谊追溯到二十年前。
tip: friend + ship(关系后缀);类似 relationship。

ex: That's very generous of you to offer.
ex_zh: 您主动提出真是太慷慨了。
tip: generosity n. 慷慨;generously adv.。

ex: I disagree with that conclusion, respectfully.
tip: 加 respectfully 更得体;disagreement n.。

ex: I get along well with my teammates.
tip: get along with sb 与某人相处;后接 well/badly。

ex: Let's try that new Italian restaurant.
ex_zh: 试试那家新开的意式餐厅吧。
tip: restaurateur 餐厅老板;fine dining 高级料理。

ex: Could I see the menu, please?
tip: wine list 酒单;set menu 套餐菜单。

ex: We shared an appetizer before the main course.
ex_zh: 主菜前我们分享了一份前菜。
tip: starter 英式西班牙 tapas 也类似。

ex: What is the main course tonight?
tip: main dish / entrée 也指主菜。

ex: Do you have room for dessert?
tip: 注意拼写 dessert(甜点)≠ desert(沙漠)。

ex: The waiter brought our drinks right away.
tip: waitress 女服务员;server 中性说法。

ex: I'd like to reserve a table for four tonight.
tip: book a table 英式;reservation n. 预订。

ex: Could we have the bill, please?
tip: check 美式;foot the bill 买单(口语)。

ex: Service was great, so I left a big tip.
ex_zh: 服务很好,所以我给了不少小费。
tip: tip n./v.;tipping culture 欧美常见 15-20%。

ex: A ten percent service charge is included.
tip: 含服务费就不必再给小费。

ex: This pasta is absolutely delicious.
ex_zh: 这 pasta 实在太好吃了。
tip: yummy 口语;tasty 也常用。

ex: Could you make it less spicy?
tip: spice n. 香料;mild / hot 表示辣度。

ex: The soup is a bit salty for me.
tip: salt n. 盐;savory 咸香的。

ex: This fish is served raw, like sashimi.
tip: raw / rare / medium / well done 是熟度阶梯。

ex: I'd like my steak medium, please.
tip: 牛排熟度:rare 一分/medium 五分/well done 全熟。

ex: Please make the burger well done.
tip: well done 也可称赞 '干得好'。

ex: Are there any vegetarian options here?
tip: vegan 纯素(连蛋奶都不吃);vegetarian 吃蛋奶。

ex: I'm allergic to nuts, please avoid them.
tip: 点单必会,关乎安全;allergy n. 过敏。

ex: What drinks do you have?
tip: beverage 更正式;soft drink 软饮。

ex: One black coffee, no sugar please.
tip: latte 拿铁/espresso 浓缩/americano 美式。

ex: A glass of red wine, please.
tip: red/white/rosé;wine list 酒单。

ex: Draft beer or bottled beer?
tip: draft 扎啤;craft beer 精酿。

ex: Can I get a refill on my coffee?
tip: re-(再)+ fill(装满);free refill 免费续杯。

ex: Let's get takeout tonight, I'm too tired.
tip: takeaway 英式;to go 美式点单用语。

ex: We have leftovers for lunch tomorrow.
tip: left(剩下)+ over;常见复数形式。

ex: Could I get a doggy bag for this?
tip: 字面 '狗食袋',但字面意思已淡化,通用说法。

ex: Breakfast is a buffet from seven to ten.
tip: 注意发音 /bʊˈfeɪ/;u 不动,h 不发音。

ex: The portions here are quite large.
tip: portion size 份量大小;half portion 半份。

ex: What is today's special?
tip: special of the day 当日推荐;也可指 '特殊的'。

ex: I'll take the lunch combo number two.
tip: combo = combination 缩写;set meal 套餐。

ex: I'd like the grilled salmon, please.
tip: I would like 缩写,比 I want 更礼貌。

ex: Can I have the check, please?
tip: Could I have 更客气;May I 最正式。

ex: Enjoy your meal! I'll be right back.
tip: bon appétit 是法语借词,也可用。

ex: A table for two, non-smoking please.
tip: 排队时最常说的一句。

ex: Could you bring an extra napkin?
tip: serviette 英式(较少用)。

ex: No straw for me, thanks.
tip: 环保趋势:paper straw 纸吸管。

ex: Cheers! Here's to the new project.
tip: 敬酒/英式谢谢/道别都可用 cheers。

ex: Bad shellfish can cause food poisoning.
ex_zh: 变质贝类会导致食物中毒。
tip: poison n. 毒;symptoms 症状包括呕吐腹泻。

ex: Do you have a reservation with us tonight?
ex_zh: 您今晚在我们这有预订吗?
tip: make/hold a reservation;book v. 预订。

ex: Could I have a clean fork and knife?
tip: 餐具总称 cutlery / silverware。

tip: 酸甜苦辣咸:sour/sweet/bitter/spicy/salty。

ex: Dark chocolate has a bitter finish.
tip: bitter melon 苦瓜;bittersweet 苦乐参半。

ex: That fried food tastes too greasy.
tip: grease n. 油脂;oily 近义。

ex: The fish here is always fresh.

ex: The restaurant is too crowded on weekends.
tip: crowd n. 人群/crowded adj. 拥挤的。

ex: Two coffees to go, please.
tip: for here 堂食;to go 外带——点单必答。

ex: I have no appetite when it's this hot.
tip: bon appétit 祝胃口好(法语借词)。

ex: Chew slowly to digest better.
tip: chewing gum 口香糖;swallow 吞咽。

ex: Let's split the bill evenly tonight.

ex: They bought a house near the park.
ex_zh: 他们在公园附近买了房。
tip: house 独栋;apartment / flat 公寓。

ex: I rent a small apartment downtown.
ex_zh: 我在市中心租了间小公寓。
tip: flat 英式;studio apartment 单身公寓。

ex: The bedroom faces the quiet garden.
tip: bed + room;master bedroom 主卧。

ex: Where is the bathroom, please?
tip: restroom / washroom 公共场合说法。

ex: We have breakfast on the balcony in summer.
ex_zh: 夏天我们在阳台吃早餐。
tip: terrace 露台(更大);patio 庭院平台。

ex: The ceiling fan keeps the room cool.
tip: 注意发音 /ˈsiːlɪŋ/;ceiling light 吸顶灯。

ex: Watch your step on the stairs.
tip: staircase 楼梯间;escalator 扶梯;elevator 电梯。

ex: I clean the kitchen every evening.
tip: clean v. 打扫 / adj. 干净的;dirty 反义。

ex: Please tidy your room before guests arrive.
tip: tidy up 收拾;untidy 凌乱的。

ex: I sweep the floor twice a week.
tip: sweep - swept - swept;broom 扫帚。

ex: Mop the floor after dinner please.
tip: mop n. 拖把 / v. 拖地;wet/dry mop。

ex: I vacuum the living room on Saturdays.
tip: vacuum cleaner 全称;hoover 英式动词。

ex: I do the laundry every Sunday morning.
tip: do the laundry 洗衣服;laundromat 自助洗衣店。

ex: Can you iron this shirt for tomorrow?
ex_zh: 能帮我熨下明天穿的衬衫吗?
tip: iron n. 熨斗/铁 v. 熨;ironing board 熨衣板。

ex: Fold the towels and put them away.
tip: unfold 展开;folder 文件夹。

ex: We recycle paper, glass and plastic.
ex_zh: 我们回收纸、玻璃和塑料。
tip: re-(再)+ cycle(循环);recycling bin 回收桶。

ex: Can you fix the leaky faucet?
ex_zh: 能修一下漏水的水龙头吗?
tip: fix / repair / mend 近义;fix 最口语。

ex: The washing machine is broken again.
tip: break - broke - broken;out of order 也可用。

ex: There is a leak under the sink.
tip: leaky adj. 漏的;leak n./v.。

ex: The light bulb in the hallway burned out.
tip: burn out 烧坏;LED bulb LED 灯泡。

ex: Turn off the switch when you leave.
tip: switch on/off 开/关;switch n./v.。

ex: Is there an outlet near the sofa?
tip: socket 英式;adapter 转换插头。

ex: Don't forget to lock the front door.
tip: lock n./v.;locksmith 锁匠;unlock 解锁。

ex: I lost my keys somewhere in the house.
ex_zh: 我把钥匙落在屋里某处了。
tip: keychain 钥匙扣;spare key 备用钥匙。

ex: Put your coat in the closet by the door.
ex_zh: 把外套放进门边的壁橱。
tip: wardrobe 衣柜(独立家具);walk-in closet 步入式衣帽间。

ex: The broom is behind the kitchen door.
tip: dustpan 簸箕;sweep with a broom。

ex: Add detergent and start the machine.
ex_zh: 加洗涤剂然后启动洗衣机。
tip: laundry detergent 洗衣液;dish soap 洗洁精。

ex: I organized the closet last weekend.
tip: organized adj. 有条理的;organization n. 组织。

ex: I'm planning to declutter my desk this week.
ex_zh: 我打算这周清理一下书桌。
tip: de-(去除)+ clutter(杂乱);源自极简主义潮流。

ex: How much is the monthly rent here?
tip: rent n./v.;for rent 招租;tenant 租客。

ex: Call the landlord if the heater breaks.
tip: landlady 女房东;tenant 房客(相对)。

ex: They took out a thirty-year mortgage.
tip: 注意发音 /ˈmɔːɡɪdʒ/;t 不发音。

ex: We saved for years to make the down payment.
ex_zh: 我们攒了好几年才付得起首付。
tip: 首付与 monthly mortgage payment 月供不同。

ex: We do grocery shopping every Saturday morning.
ex_zh: 我们每周六上午采购日用品。
tip: groceries n. 食品杂货;grocery store 杂货店。

ex: Please take out the trash before you go.
tip: 美式 trash / 英式 rubbish;take out 拿出去。

ex: I'll cook if you do the dishes.
tip: do the washing-up 英式;dishwasher 洗碗机。

ex: Make the bed before you leave the room.
ex_zh: 离开房间前整理好床铺。
tip: bed-making 是常见的 morning routine。

ex: Could you water the plants while I'm away?
ex_zh: 我不在时能帮忙浇花吗?
tip: water v. 浇水;plant n. 植物 v. 种植。

ex: The shower drain is clogged again.
tip: clog v. 堵塞;plunger 马桶吸子(疏通工具)。

ex_zh: 我们上个月搬进来的,很喜欢这里。
tip: move out 搬出;move n./v. 搬家。

tip: neighbor 邻居 + hood(区域后缀)。

ex: We grow tomatoes in the back garden.
tip: gardening n. 园艺;gardener 园丁。
