tip: cellar 地窖(存酒);basement 地下室。

ex: The renovation will take about two months.
tip: renovate v. 翻新;remodel 美式同义。

ex: This little apartment feels very cozy.
tip: 英式拼写 cosy;比 comfortable 更重氛围感。

ex: Sorry the room is a bit messy today.
tip: mess n. 杂乱 / messy adj.;make a mess 弄乱。

ex: Call a plumber; the toilet is overflowing.
tip: plumbing n. 管道系统;electrician 电工。

ex: We spent the weekend on home improvement projects.
ex_zh: 我们周末在做家装改善。
tip: DIY (do it yourself) 自己动手做家装。

ex: The kick-off meeting for CGL No.3 is confirmed for 8 April; I will circulate the agenda and the interface list two working days in advance.
sc: 宣布新产线项目正式启动、确认范围与各方接口人时使用
tip: 德式开场忌寒暄，第一句就给目的和时间；会前 48 小时发议程是基本礼貌

ex: I have put three items on the agenda: HSM No.2 mechanical installation, the overdue progress payment, and the Caster No.1 upgrade scope.
sc: 会前发出议程，或开场时说明本次汇报要覆盖的议题与顺序
tip: 先说 'three items'，再展开，德国老板喜欢先知道全局结构

ex: The action item from last week — revising the FAT test plan for the coiler — is closed; the updated plan was signed off on Tuesday.
sc: 复盘上次会议决议的落实情况，体现闭环
tip: 必带三要素：动作 + owner + due date。'closed / open / overdue' 三态要说清

ex: We will run a quick round-robin update: mechanical, electrical and automation, five minutes each, then I will summarise the risks.
sc: 组织多专业团队轮流汇报、控制每人时长的会议安排
tip: 'X minutes each' 是控场关键，德式会议极重视准时

ex: The weekly status report went out this morning: CGL No.3 is at 68 percent complete, two days behind the baseline schedule.
sc: 提交或引用书面周报，作为口头汇报的事实基础
tip: 口头汇报必须与书面报告的数据完全一致，德国老板会对照看

ex: To recap the last three points: the gearbox is on site, the alignment is still pending, and SAT cannot start before 20 June.
sc: 会议中段或结尾做小结，确保双方理解一致
tip: 'To recap' 后只列结论，不重复论证过程

ex: Next steps: the site team starts the no-load trial run on Monday, and I will confirm the SAT window with the client by Friday.
sc: 收尾前明确下一步动作，是德式会议收口的必备环节
tip: 每个 next step 都要能回答 who 和 by when，否则老板会当场追问

ex: I will follow up with the OEM today and come back to you with a firm date for the spare-parts delivery.
sc: 承诺自己去追某个未决事项，体现主动性
tip: 注意 follow up with + 人，follow up on + 事；'a firm date' 比 'soon' 可信得多

zh: 限时（控制某项讨论时长）
ex: Let's time-box the payment discussion to ten minutes so we still cover the HSM commissioning plan.
sc: 防止某个议题占用过多时间、控制会议节奏
tip: 动词用法：time-box something to ten minutes

zh: 待议清单（暂不展开的问题）
ex: The zinc pot refractory question goes to the parking lot; it does not affect the critical path this month.
sc: 记录次要问题但不占用当前会议时间
tip: 放进 parking lot 时必须说明为什么它不影响关键路径，否则老板会认为你在回避

ex: The retention-money calculation is detailed; let's take it offline and I will send you a written breakdown today.
sc: 把复杂细节移出大会，会后单独处理并留书面记录
tip: 一定补一句 'and I will send you a written summary'，否则会被视为推脱

ex: To wrap up: three action items, two owners, and all due dates before next Monday.
sc: 会议结束前的收口总结
tip: 数字化的收尾最有效：几个行动项、几个责任人、什么期限

ex: The next milestone is mechanical completion of the HSM No.2 mill stands, currently forecast for 30 September.
sc: 说明下一个关键节点是什么、当前预测何时达成
tip: 'currently forecast for' 表示这是预测而非承诺，给自己留余地

ex: Against the baseline schedule we are four working days behind, caused by the late delivery of the main drive.
sc: 把实际进度与批准的基准计划做对比，是德式进度汇报的标准动作
tip: 永远说 'against the baseline'，给出偏差量，而不是笼统说 'a bit late'

ex: The critical path now runs through the annealing furnace refractory work; any slippage there moves the go-live date directly.
sc: 说明当前决定总工期的那条链路，以及它的变化
tip: 'runs through' 是描述关键路径的常用搭配

ex: The uncoiler assembly is ahead of schedule by one week, which gives us buffer before the cold trial run.
sc: 汇报提前完成的部分，并说明它带来的缓冲价值
tip: 好消息也要量化：'by one week'，并说明这笔缓冲要用在哪里

ex: The CGL No.3 welding machine is behind schedule by five working days due to an OEM firmware delay.
sc: 说明某项交付延误，需同时给出偏差量、原因与应对
tip: 固定搭配：behind schedule by + 天数 + due to + 原因，一句话讲完事实与归因

ex: The Caster No.1 control upgrade is on track at 82 percent complete, with no open issues on the risk register.
sc: 确认某项工作正常推进，通常配合完成百分比使用
tip: 说 on track 后最好补一个数据支撑，否则显得空

ex: Total slippage on HSM No.2 is now nine days; I have a recovery plan but it needs two extra weekend shifts.
sc: 汇报累计延误天数和追赶方案
tip: slippage 是不可数的延误量，用 'total slippage is X days'；主动给 recovery plan

ex: The deliverable for this phase is the complete spare-parts list, to be submitted to the client for approval by 15 May.
sc: 说明本阶段要交出的具体成果，常用于阶段门评审
tip: deliverable 必须有验收标准和时间，模糊的 deliverable 在德国老板那里不算数

ex: We cannot pass the phase gate until the safety interlocks are validated and the SIL assessment is signed.
sc: 说明进入下一阶段前必须满足的硬性条件
tip: 'pass / clear the phase gate'；未通过时直接列出缺什么

ex: The ETA for the gearbox is 12 June, assuming the supplier ships from Duisburg next week as committed.
sc: 回答某项设备或物料何时到场
tip: 加 'assuming ...' 说明前提，避免把供应商的口头承诺说成自己的承诺

ex: Mechanical installation of the processing line is 74 percent complete, measured against the agreed progress curve.
sc: 量化进度，是德式汇报最核心的一个数字
tip: 务必说明算法（measured against ...），百分比口径不一致会被当场质疑

ex: The bottleneck is not manpower but the single overhead crane, which limits us to two lifts per shift.
sc: 指出真正的制约因素，为要资源提供依据
tip: 先否定一个常见猜测再给真相（'not X but Y'），表达清晰且有洞察

ex: The lead time for the work rolls has stretched from 14 to 22 weeks, which threatens the December shutdown window.
sc: 说明采购周期变化及其对节点的影响
tip: 'has stretched from X to Y' 比 'is longer' 有力得多

ex: All hot work must be finished inside the ten-day shutdown window in October; missing it means a six-month delay.
sc: 冶金产线改造中说明施工窗口的刚性约束
tip: 务必说清错过窗口的代价（'missing it means ...'），让老板理解为什么不能拖

ex: The downtime trend over the last three months is clearly downward, from 14 hours to 6 hours per month.
sc: 描述指标变化方向，配合图表或报表使用
tip: 方向 + 起点终点数据，一句话给全

ex: Line availability shows a clear uptrend since the AGC retrofit, up 11 percent quarter-on-quarter.
sc: 汇报正向指标改善，佐证改造成效
tip: 'shows a clear uptrend' 比 'is getting better' 专业

ex: Strip thickness deviation shows a steady downtrend and is now well inside the contractual tolerance.
sc: 汇报偏差或损耗类指标的改善
tip: 'well inside the tolerance' 是很有力的一句话，说明不只是达标，是有余量

zh: 偏差（实际 vs 计划）
ex: The schedule variance for HSM No.2 is plus five days against baseline, driven by the drive-motor lead time.
sc: 量化实际与计划的差异，是德国老板看报表第一眼找的数字
tip: variance 后跟具体数值和归因，不说 'some variance'

ex: Any deviation from the agreed specification must go through change control before we start the work.
sc: 说明技术偏离必须走流程，也用于质量偏差汇报
tip: deviation from + 标准；技术语境下强调流程合规

ex: Spare-parts consumption is down 18 percent quarter-on-quarter after we switched to the new roll material.
sc: 按季度对比数据，常用于效益汇报
tip: 对比必须说清基准：QoQ 环比、YoY 同比，混用会被纠正

ex: The March downtime figure is an outlier — a one-off bearing failure, now closed, not a systemic problem.
sc: 解释报表中某个突兀数据，防止老板误判成趋势
tip: 主动指出 outlier 并给出归因，比等老板问更显专业

ex: Throughput has reached a plateau at 1.9 million tonnes per year; further gains need a furnace upgrade.
sc: 说明产能或指标停滞，引出下一步投资需求
tip: 'reached a plateau at + 数值'，随后给出突破方案，不要只报停滞

ex: The top risk on CGL No.3 is the zinc pot delivery; if it slips past August, the whole commissioning sequence shifts.
sc: 风险登记册汇报中列出首要风险及其触发条件
tip: risk 讲'如果发生会怎样'，issue 讲'已经发生了'；两者不要混用

ex: We now have an open issue on the HSM gearbox: oil leakage found during the no-load run, root cause analysis under way.
sc: 报告已经发生、正在处理的现场问题
tip: issue 必须配状态：open / being investigated / closed

ex: I am escalating the main-drive failure to you now because without a decision on the replacement it blocks the SAT date.
sc: 把超出自己权限或资源的问题正式上报给老板
tip: 升级时说清'为什么现在找你'和'需要你决定什么'，德国老板反感无诉求的上报

ex: Per the escalation path, I informed the client project manager first; if there is no response in 48 hours it goes to the steering committee.
sc: 说明问题上报的层级与时间规则
tip: 有明确规则会让老板觉得你在按制度办事，而不是甩锅

ex: Mitigation: we reroute the tension control through the backup PLC, which caps the downtime at four hours.
sc: 针对已识别风险给出降低影响的具体动作
tip: 'Mitigation:' 直接开头接动作，并给量化效果（caps ... at ...）

ex: Our contingency plan is to rent a mobile hydraulic unit for two weeks; I have a quote and can mobilise within 72 hours.
sc: 说明风险真发生时的备用方案与启动成本
tip: 好的 contingency plan 要说明启动条件和启动时间，而不只是'有备选'

ex: The root cause was not the motor but a misaligned coupling; we corrected the alignment and re-ran the test successfully.
sc: 汇报问题溯源结果，说明已验证有效
tip: 'The root cause was X, not Y' 这种排除式表达在德式汇报中很加分

ex: I have added the OEM insolvency risk to the risk register with a medium impact and a high probability rating.
sc: 正式记录并跟踪风险，是项目治理的标准动作
tip: 风险要带 impact 与 probability 评级，并显示 owner

ex: Early warning: the OEM lead time for the servo drives has slipped to 12 weeks, which threatens our Q4 go-live.
sc: 在问题真正爆发之前主动示警
tip: 'Early warning:' 开头，德式管理极度偏好提前预警而非事后解释

ex: One red flag I want to raise: the client has not yet confirmed the shutdown window, and we are eight weeks out.
sc: 在例会中主动点出需要警惕的信号
tip: 'I want to raise' 比 'I think' 更正式有力

ex: This is a showstopper if not resolved by Friday: without the safety sign-off we cannot energise the mill.
sc: 说明会直接阻断项目推进的关键障碍
tip: showstopper 是强词，用之前确认真的无替代路径；务必带截止时间

ex: As a workaround we run the line at 70 percent speed; it holds the delivery date but costs us about three percent of output.
sc: 说明绕过问题的临时办法及其代价
tip: 说 workaround 必须同时说代价，否则老板会以为问题已解决

ex: Lessons learned from Caster No.1: we now freeze the automation scope 12 weeks before FAT, not four.
sc: 复盘总结，体现持续改进
tip: 经验必须落到可执行的规则改变上，'以后要更小心'不算经验

ex: Ownership of the interface problem sits with the mechanical contractor; I have that confirmed in writing.
sc: 明确某项问题的责任方，避免扯皮
tip: ownership 后跟 sits with + 责任方；书面确认是德式项目的护身符

ex: The single overhead crane is a single point of failure for the whole installation; I recommend a second unit for four weeks.
sc: 指出系统或资源中无冗余的脆弱环节
tip: 指出 SPOF 的同时一定要给建议，否则只是抱怨

zh: 残余风险（缓解后仍存的风险）
ex: After the workaround the residual risk is low, but I will keep the interlock fault on the risk register until SAT confirms it.
sc: 说明采取措施后仍保留的风险及关闭条件
tip: 说清'什么时候可以摘掉这个风险'，体现闭环思维

ex: I have revised the resource allocation for September: four fitters on the mill stands, two on the processing line.
sc: 说明人力/设备资源在各工作面上的分配
tip: 给具体数字，不要说 'we allocated more people'

ex: The current staffing for commissioning is six engineers on site; the plan assumed eight, and I am closing the gap from back-office.
sc: 汇报实际到岗人数与计划的差距
tip: 对比 'current vs planned'，再给补齐方案

ex: There is a skill gap in safety-integrity validation; I propose a two-day OEM training for the on-site team next month.
sc: 指出团队能力不足并给出解决建议
tip: 只说缺人/缺技能会被视为抱怨，必须配培训或补充方案

ex: The mechanical subcontractor is two fitters short this week; I have escalated to their site manager and asked for a written recovery plan.
sc: 汇报分包商履约情况，尤其是人员或进度不足
tip: 对分包商的问题要留书面记录，德式项目极重证据链

ex: The on-site team has been on the Nordstahl site for eleven weeks; I am rotating two members out next Friday to avoid fatigue risk.
sc: 汇报现场团队状态、轮换与长期驻场安排
tip: 主动提疲劳与轮换，体现对安全和可持续性的关注

ex: I need one controls engineer from back-office for three weeks to protect the SAT date.
sc: 向总部或后台部门申请增援
tip: 申请支援要说清'要多久、为了守住哪个节点'

zh: 人力余量（可承接工作的余量）
ex: My bandwidth this month is fully saturated; taking on the Caster No.1 upgrade now would put the CGL schedule at risk.
sc: 说明自己或团队已无余量，婉拒新增任务
tip: 'saturated' 比 'busy' 精确；拒绝时给出'接了会牺牲什么'

ex: Crane utilization is already at 92 percent; adding a second shift is the only way to recover the four lost days.
sc: 用利用率数据说明资源是否已到极限
tip: 利用率是德式管理最爱看的数字，汇报资源问题优先用它

ex: The rolling mill at HSM No.2 has six stands in the finishing train; we are replacing the mechanical parts of stands F1 to F3.
sc: 泛指轧机本体时汇报改造范围与工作面
tip: 'finishing train' 精轧机组、'roughing mill' 粗轧机，说清是哪个机组

ex: HSM No.2 is our largest site project this year: 1.9 million tonnes per year, with a scheduled shutdown window of ten days in October.
sc: 介绍主项目规模与约束时使用
tip: 介绍项目先给产能档位和窗口约束，德国老板据此判断优先级

ex: CGL No.3 is a continuous galvanizing line — a processing line running at 120 metres per minute with a 45-metre annealing furnace.
sc: 介绍处理线类项目（镀锌、酸洗、退火、彩涂等）的类型与参数
tip: 处理线要报速度（m/min）和炉长，这是判断复杂度的关键参数

ex: The Caster No.1 upgrade is smaller in scope: two strands, control system renewal only, no mechanical modification.
sc: 说明连铸机项目范围，尤其是'只动控制不动机械'
tip: 明确区分 'control system' 与 'mechanical' 范围，避免对方误判工作量

ex: All six mill stands are now mechanically installed; stand F4 is waiting for the hydraulic AGC cylinder.
sc: 汇报轧机机架安装进度
tip: 按 F1-F6 编号逐个说状态，德式工程汇报要求精确到单体设备

ex: The work rolls for stands F1 to F3 were delivered on Monday, but the grinding is not done and that pushes the roll-change trial by three days.
sc: 汇报辊系到货、磨削与换辊试验进度
tip: 'grinding / roll change / roll stack' 是辊系三件套，配套说

ex: The hydraulic AGC retrofit is the main reason for this investment: it improves thickness tolerance from plus-minus 60 to plus-minus 25 microns.
sc: 说明厚度控制改造的技术价值，用于向老板证明投资合理性
tip: 技术项汇报要给改造前后的对比数据，这是德式技术沟通的核心

ex: The coiler mandrel shows abnormal vibration above 400 rpm; we are balancing it before the next trial run.
sc: 汇报卷取机设备状态与处理措施
tip: 设备异常要说清触发条件（above 400 rpm），而不是笼统说 'has a problem'

ex: The uncoiler of CGL No.3 is installed and aligned; the strip centring control still needs tuning during the cold run.
sc: 汇报处理线入口段设备安装状态
tip: 'installed / aligned / commissioned' 三态要分清，不能含糊

ex: The bridle rolls in the furnace entry section are replaced; the tension control loop is stable at the tested speed.
sc: 汇报处理线张力辊更换与张力控制调试结果
tip: 处理线常说 'entry / process / exit section' 入口/工艺/出口段

ex: Refractory work in the annealing furnace is the critical path; it needs 18 days of curing before we can heat up.
sc: 说明炉区施工及养护周期对总工期的约束
tip: 炉区必有 'curing / dry-out / heat-up' 养护烘炉周期，要提前预警

ex: The zinc pot is the long-lead item on CGL No.3: 26 weeks from order to site, and we are now in week 19.
sc: 汇报长周期设备的采购进度
tip: 长周期件要报 'X weeks from order to site, now in week Y'

ex: The strip welder passed the weld-test on 1.2 mm material; we still need to qualify the 2.0 mm grade before the trial run.
sc: 汇报处理线焊机调试与钢种认证进度
tip: 'qualify a grade / weld-test' 是处理线调试的标准说法

ex: The main drive for stand F2 is back from repair; the insulation resistance test is clean and we will re-install it tomorrow.
sc: 汇报主传动电机/变频设备的检修与复装
tip: 电气设备复装前必提 'insulation resistance test'，这是德式验收的硬指标

ex: The gearbox oil analysis shows elevated iron content; we are investigating and will report the root cause by Friday.
sc: 汇报齿轮箱异常及排查安排
tip: 异常汇报要带'何时给结论'，否则老板会追问

ex: The hydraulic system for the AGC is flushed and filled; the pressure test is scheduled for Wednesday with the client inspector present.
sc: 汇报液压系统冲洗、打压与见证试验
tip: 'flushing / pressure test / with inspector present' 是液压调试标准流程

ex: Mechanical installation on HSM No.2 is 74 percent complete; electrical installation trails it by about ten days as planned.
sc: 汇报机、电、自动化三专业安装进度及相互搭接
tip: 机、电、自动化三条曲线分开报，并说明滞后的搭接关系

ex: Final alignment of the mill train is done to within 0.05 millimetres; the client surveyor signed the alignment record yesterday.
sc: 汇报设备安装精度与第三方见证
tip: 精度汇报给具体公差数值，并说明谁签的字

ex: Commissioning of CGL No.3 starts on 4 May; the on-site team is staffed for a fourteen-week window including the performance test.
sc: 宣布调试启动时间、团队配置与周期
tip: 调试要报'窗口周数'和是否含性能考核，这是工作量判断依据

ex: FAT on the coiler control cubicles passed all 38 test cases; the only open item is a label correction, non-critical.
sc: 汇报出厂前测试结果与遗留问题
tip: 报 FAT 要给用例总数和通过数，'non-critical' 说明未通过项的影响等级

ex: SAT cannot start before 20 June because the annealing furnace is still curing; I have a recovery plan but it depends on the second shift.
sc: 说明现场验收的前提条件与制约
tip: SAT 是付款节点，被推迟必须同步通报对收款的影响

ex: The punch list currently has six open items, three of which block SAT sign-off; I expect to clear all three by next Wednesday.
sc: 汇报验收前遗留问题数量、阻断性与清除计划
tip: 必须区分 'blocking' 与 'non-blocking' 尾项，并给清除日期

ex: I need your sign-off on the SAT report before we can hand over to the operations team and release the next payment milestone.
sc: 请求签字确认，并说明签字带来的商务后果
tip: 请求签字时同步说明'不签会卡住什么'，推动决策

ex: The cold trial run is scheduled for Monday and the hot trial run for 20 June; both require the client operations team on site.
sc: 区分冷试、热试并说明前提条件
tip: 'cold run / hot run / no-load test / load test' 要分清楚

ex: Go-live for HSM No.2 is planned for 1 October, assuming SAT sign-off by 15 September and no open safety items.
sc: 宣布正式投产日期及其前提
tip: 'assuming ... and no open ...' 把前提条件说全，避免被当成硬承诺

ex: The performance test runs for 72 continuous hours; the contractual guarantees are 1.9 million tonnes per year and 95 percent availability.
sc: 说明考核时长与合同保证值
tip: 性能考核要报'合同保证值'，这是罚则触发的边界

ex: We are in the ramp-up phase: the line is at 65 percent of design speed, and we expect to reach full speed within four weeks.
sc: 汇报投产后产能提升进度
tip: 爬坡期给百分比和达产预期，是老板最关心的产能兑现

ex: Unplanned downtime last month was six hours, down from fourteen in March; the main contributor was a bearing failure on the bridle roll.
sc: 汇报停机时长、趋势与主要原因
tip: downtime 必须区分 planned / unplanned，并给归因

ex: Line uptime is now 94 percent, against a contractual guarantee of 95 percent; we are closing the last percentage point with the tension control tuning.
sc: 汇报可用率与合同保证值的差距
tip: 主动报'还差多少到保证值'，比等老板发现好得多

ex: An unplanned shutdown on Monday cost us eleven production hours; the root cause was a faulty limit switch, now replaced.
sc: 汇报非计划停产事件与损失
tip: 停产汇报要给小时数和根因，德国老板会算损失金额

ex: We scheduled the PLC retrofit inside the planned turnaround in October, which avoids any additional production loss.
sc: 说明利用大修窗口施工以规避产能损失
tip: 'avoids additional production loss' 是有力的价值论证

ex: All safety interlocks are verified; the emergency-stop loop meets SIL 2 as per the specification, and the test record is signed.
sc: 汇报安全联锁验证结果与合规等级
tip: 安全项语气要肯定，附测试记录与签字；'as per the specification' 强调合规

ex: Safety integrity is our top priority on this site; no function goes into service before the interlock validation is complete.
sc: 强调安全优先原则，回应老板对安全合规的关注
tip: 在德国项目里安全议题零妥协，主动表态比被动回答好

ex: The emergency-stop circuit is assessed at SIL 2; upgrading to SIL 3 would require a new safety PLC and about eight weeks.
sc: 说明安全等级评定结果及升级代价
tip: 提 SIL 时同步说明升级成本与时间，让老板自己权衡

ex: The acceptance criteria were agreed in the contract in March; anything outside them is a change request, not a defect.
sc: 明确验收边界，防止客户把超范围要求当缺陷
tip: 这句话是挡住无理索赔的关键，语气要平静但坚定

ex: The warranty period is twelve months from SAT sign-off, which is also when the retention money is released.
sc: 说明质保期长度及其与质保金释放的关联
tip: 把质保期和尾款/质保金绑定说明，商务与技术一起讲

ex: Per the contract, the 30 percent advance payment falls due within 15 days of the PO date; I issued the pro forma invoice last Friday and it is still unpaid.
sc: A 催客户支付预付款；B 向老板说明预付款未到账，需要对方协助推动
tip: 'falls due within X days of ...' 引用合同条款最有力；催预付款时永远先引合同条款再说情面

ex: The down payment of EUR 1.8 million was received on 12 March, so the order is now financially released for procurement.
sc: 确认首付款到账，并说明它解锁了采购动作
tip: 'financially released' 是内部术语，说明钱到账才启动采购

ex: The second progress payment of EUR 1.2 million is linked to FAT sign-off, which we completed on 12 March; the invoice was submitted the same day.
sc: A 提醒客户进度款已到付款节点；B 向老板说明进度款与里程碑的对应关系
tip: 进度款汇报要讲清'付款触发条件已满足'，并给出完成日期佐证

ex: Three milestone payments remain: 20 percent at FAT, 30 percent at shipment, and 10 percent at SAT sign-off.
sc: 向老板或客户梳理剩余付款节点与比例
tip: 把付款节点按时间轴一次列清，老板最想看的就是这张'钱什么时候进来'的图

ex: The final payment of 10 percent is due 30 days after SAT sign-off; I will issue the invoice the day we receive the signed SAT report.
sc: 说明尾款比例、触发条件与开票安排
tip: 尾款容易被拖，提前锁定触发条件并书面确认

ex: The 10 percent retention money is released twelve months after SAT sign-off, or on expiry of the warranty period, whichever is earlier.
sc: 说明质保金比例与释放条件
tip: 'whichever is earlier' 是合同条款常用表述，务必原样记住并复述

ex: Our payment terms are 30 percent advance, 60 percent against milestones and 10 percent retention, net 30 days from invoice date.
sc: 向客户或新同事说明合同付款结构
tip: 'net 30 days' 指发票日起 30 天内全额付清；说清起算点是避免争议的关键

ex: Invoice number 2026-0417 for EUR 860,000 was issued on 3 April and is now 45 days past due; I have sent two reminders by email.
sc: B 向老板说明某张发票的状态与已采取的动作
tip: 报发票必带四要素：编号、金额、开票日、逾期天数

ex: I have issued the pro forma invoice for the advance payment; the client needs it before their finance team can register the payment request.
sc: A 向客户说明已提供形式发票以便其走内部付款流程
tip: 形式发票常是客户内部立项的必备文件，主动提供能显著缩短回款周期

ex: The due date was 18 May; we are now 45 days beyond it, and I have asked their finance team to confirm a firm payment date in writing.
sc: A/B 通用：明确逾期起点，并要求对方书面确认付款日
tip: 'a firm payment date in writing' 是催收的核心诉求，口头承诺不算数

ex: Two invoices totalling EUR 860,000 are overdue; the reason given is an internal budget freeze, not a dispute over quality or scope.
sc: B 向老板解释逾期金额、时长与真实原因
tip: 解释逾期时务必区分原因是'流程/预算'还是'争议'，这决定风险等级和应对策略

ex: The total outstanding payment from Nordstahl is EUR 2.4 million, of which EUR 860,000 is more than 45 days past due.
sc: B 向老板汇总客户欠款总额及账龄结构
tip: 先给总额再拆账龄，老板一眼能判断严重程度

ex: Our accounts receivable for this project stand at EUR 2.4 million; I review the position with their finance controller every Thursday.
sc: B 向老板汇报应收账款规模与跟踪机制
tip: 汇报应收时同时说明'我有什么机制在跟'，比只报数字更让人放心

ex: According to the aging report, EUR 860,000 is in the 31-to-60-day bucket and EUR 1.5 million is current; nothing has gone beyond 90 days.
sc: B 用账龄表向老板分类说明欠款分布
tip: 'current / 31-60 days / 61-90 days / over 90 days' 是账龄标准分档，务必按分档说

ex: I have sent three payment reminders: two by email to their accounts payable team and one formal letter to the project manager.
sc: B 向老板说明自己已做的催收动作与升级层级
tip: 说明催收动作时要逐级列出，展示你已按流程走到位

ex: If the balance is not settled by 30 June, I will issue a formal dunning letter and copy their head of procurement.
sc: B 向老板报备下一步催收动作；A 向客户预告正式催款
tip: 催款函要预告（'if not settled by X, I will ...'），既施压又留余地

ex: Collection on this account is my top priority this month; I have a call with their CFO on Friday and will report the outcome to you the same day.
sc: B 向老板汇报催收优先级与具体安排
tip: 把回款说成 'my top priority' 并给出下一步动作，展示主动性

ex: If this payment slips past July, our cash flow for Q3 will be negative; that is why I am asking for your support to escalate it now.
sc: B 向老板说明逾期对本公司现金流的影响，以争取升级支持
tip: 把收款问题上升到现金流后果，是说服老板介入的最有效方式

ex: We hold a bank guarantee for the advance payment, valid until December; if they default we can call it, but that would damage the relationship.
sc: B 向老板说明可用的金融保障手段及其代价
tip: 'call the guarantee' 是最后手段，提的时候要同时评估关系代价

ex: If the outstanding balance is not cleared by 30 June, I recommend we suspend the spare-parts shipment; I need your approval before I inform the client.
sc: B 向老板提出施压方案并请求授权
tip: 暂停发货是重大商务动作，必须'先请示、后告知'，切忌自行宣布

ex: The scope covers mechanical, electrical and automation for HSM No.2; civil works and the crane are explicitly excluded.
sc: 明确项目边界，尤其是'不包含什么'
tip: 德式项目里'explicitly excluded'和包含项一样重要，务必说清

ex: The client added three HMI screens without a change request; that is scope creep and it will push FAT by a week.
sc: 识别并指出客户在未经变更流程的情况下追加需求
tip: 发现 scope creep 要立刻点名并量化影响，拖久了就变成默认范围

ex: I have logged a formal change request for the additional strip grades; the impact is four weeks and EUR 180,000.
sc: 把客户的新需求转为正式变更，并给出工期与成本影响
tip: 德式回应追加需求的标准句式：'I have logged a CR, impact is X weeks and EUR Y'

ex: Per our change control process, no modification starts before the client confirms the cost and schedule impact in writing.
sc: 拒绝口头变更、坚持走流程
tip: 'no ... before ... in writing' 是挡住口头变更最有效的句式

ex: The thickness tolerance in the specification is plus-minus 25 microns; what the client now asks for is plus-minus 15, which our current AGC cannot hold.
sc: 引用规格书条款说明技术边界
tip: 谈技术争议时引用 spec 具体条款和数值，比讲道理有效

ex: The interface between our automation and their Level 2 system is not yet defined; I need that frozen by end of May.
sc: 说明跨系统或跨承包商的责任分界与冻结时间
tip: 'freeze the interface by + 日期' 是进度保护的常用表达

ex: System integration with the existing Level 2 is the highest technical risk; we plan a two-week integration test before SAT.
sc: 说明集成工作的风险与验证安排
tip: 集成风险要提前排测试窗口，不能等到 SAT 才第一次联调

ex: We retrofit the existing mill with a new hydraulic AGC while keeping the original safety interlocks untouched.
sc: 说明在既有产线上做改造、保留哪些部分
tip: 'while keeping ... untouched' 说明改造边界，减少客户对风险的担心

ex: The legacy system is a 1990s PLC platform with no vendor support; keeping it would mean an unacceptable single point of failure.
sc: 论证为何必须替换老旧系统
tip: 论证替换时要把技术风险转成业务语言（不可接受的单点故障）

ex: Our fallback option is to keep the old tension control for the first month; it is slower but it keeps the line running.
sc: 说明技术风险发生时的退路
tip: 报 fallback 要说明代价（'slower'），不能让人以为没有损失

ex: I have asked the OEM to confirm technical feasibility by Friday; without it we cannot commit to the July date.
sc: 说明某项技术要求还在评估中，暂不能承诺
tip: 未确认可行时绝不承诺日期，说清'缺什么确认'

ex: The design review is on 20 May; the client has to approve the mechanical layout before we release the drawings for manufacturing.
sc: 说明设计评审节点及其对下游的解锁作用
tip: 'release for manufacturing' 是设计冻结后的关键动作，评审汇报要提到

ex: The trade-off is clear: a distributed SCADA cuts downtime but raises CAPEX by 9 percent. My recommendation is to accept it.
sc: 向老板呈现选项的利弊并给出推荐
tip: 德式决策要求你给推荐而不是只给选项，'My recommendation is ...' 必须有

ex: The new drive is fully compatible with the existing gearbox, so we avoid a mechanical modification and save about three weeks.
sc: 说明新设备与既有系统的兼容性及其收益
tip: 兼容性汇报连带说明省了什么，把技术细节转成进度价值

ex: The client has asked for a two-year spare-parts package; I will submit the quotation together with the recommended list next week.
sc: 说明备件包报价与清单交付安排
tip: 备件常是项目后的持续收入点，汇报时要主动推

ex: The main drive converter is a critical spare: without it the whole mill stops, so I recommend keeping one in stock on site.
sc: 论证某项备件必须常备库存
tip: 'without it the whole line stops' 是论证关键备件最有说服力的依据

ex: The work roll assembly is treated as a capital spare; it is worth EUR 400,000 and is depreciated over ten years.
sc: 说明高价值备件的财务处理方式
tip: 资本性备件涉及 CAPEX 审批，汇报时说明金额与折旧年限

ex: Wear parts such as bearings and seals are excluded from the warranty and are billed separately as consumables.
sc: 区分易损件与质保范围，避免索赔纠纷
tip: 'excluded from the warranty' 这句话能挡掉大量索赔，务必说清

ex: Hydraulic oil and filter elements are consumables; we supply the first fill and the client reorders through our after-sales team.
sc: 说明消耗品的供货边界与后续采购渠道
tip: 消耗品是售后粘性业务，说明复购路径

ex: The original PLC module is obsolete and no longer available; we propose a substitute with the same function and a documented equivalence check.
sc: 说明原型号停产并提供替代方案
tip: 替代件必须附 'equivalence check' 等价性确认，德国客户会严格审查

ex: The recommended spare-parts list covers 148 items for two years of operation; the client must approve it before we place the order.
sc: 提交备件清单并说明审批要求
tip: 清单要给条目数和覆盖年限，方便老板判断金额量级

ex: Their inventory of work rolls is down to two sets, which covers about six weeks; I have flagged the replenishment risk to the client.
sc: 提醒客户库存不足及补货风险
tip: 库存汇报用'还能撑多久'表达，比库存数量更能触发行动

ex: Procurement of the long-lead items started in January; the zinc pot and the main drive converter are the two items on the critical path.
sc: 说明采购进展与关键长周期件
tip: 'long-lead items' 长周期件要单独跟踪并上报

ex: After-sales service is handled by our Duisburg team; response time under the service contract is 24 hours for critical failures.
sc: 说明售后响应机制与承诺时效
tip: 售后汇报给具体响应时效，这是服务能力的核心指标

ex: I propose we offer a three-year service contract with two scheduled inspections per year; it secures recurring revenue and locks in the client.
sc: 向老板提议签署长期服务合同并说明商业价值
tip: 'secures recurring revenue and locks in the client' 是老板最想听的商业逻辑

ex: Field service will send two engineers for the annual inspection; travel and accommodation are billed at cost as per the contract.
sc: 安排厂家工程师到场服务并说明计费方式
tip: 'billed at cost as per the contract' 说明计费依据，避免后续争议

ex: The approved budget for HSM No.2 is EUR 18.4 million; we have committed 62 percent of it so far.
sc: 汇报预算总额与已承诺比例
tip: 'committed' 已承诺 ≠ 'spent' 已花费，两者都要能给

ex: We have a cost overrun of 7 percent against the cost baseline, driven by extended commissioning; the contingency budget still covers it.
sc: 汇报超支幅度、原因及是否仍在应急预算内
tip: 超支汇报三件套：幅度 + 归因 + 是否可控，缺一不可

ex: The mill stand replacement is CAPEX and needs board approval; the spare-parts package can be booked as OPEX.
sc: 区分资本性支出与运营支出，说明审批层级
tip: 德式财务对 CAPEX/OPEX 划分极敏感，说错会影响审批路径

ex: Consumables and the annual service contract are OPEX, so the client can approve them at plant level without head office.
sc: 说明运营支出的审批便利性，推动快速成交
tip: 把支出归为 OPEX 能显著降低客户决策门槛，是谈判技巧

ex: We still have EUR 900,000 of contingency budget, which is 5 percent of the total; I do not intend to touch it before SAT.
sc: 说明应急预算余额与动用原则
tip: 主动说明不轻易动用应急预算，体现成本纪律

ex: At the current burn rate the phase-two budget will be exhausted three weeks early unless we defer the retrofit scope.
sc: 预警预算将提前耗尽及应对选项
tip: burn rate 预警要带'除非做什么'，给老板决策选项

ex: Against the cost baseline we are 3 percent under budget on mechanical, but 11 percent over on commissioning.
tip: 分专业拆开报，隐藏在总数里的超支会被老板当场拆穿

ex: Project margin is currently 12.4 percent, down from 15 percent at contract award because of the extended commissioning.
sc: 汇报项目毛利变化及原因
tip: 毛利下滑要给归因和改善动作，只报数字会被追问

ex: I have requested a quote from the OEM for the substitute module; I expect it within five working days and will share it with you.
sc: 说明询价进展与反馈时间
tip: 报价汇报要说明'什么时候能给'，让老板知道何时能看到数

ex: The added strip grades require a variation order of EUR 180,000 and four weeks; I will not start the work before it is signed.
sc: 把技术变更转为带费用的商务变更指令
tip: 'I will not start before it is signed' 是保护利润的关键表态

ex: The key stakeholders are the plant manager, the maintenance head and the operations shift leaders; the last group is often overlooked.
sc: 梳理项目关键干系人，尤其是容易被忽略的操作层
tip: 提到操作工/维护方为干系人会显得你懂现场，这是加分项

ex: I need the sponsor to decide on the second shift by Friday; without that decision the October shutdown window is at risk.
sc: 向出资方提出决策请求并说明后果
tip: 向 sponsor 要决策时必须给截止时间和不决策的代价

ex: I will present the recovery plan to the steering committee on 20 June; the decision on the second shift has to come from there.
sc: 说明需要上会决策的事项
tip: 说明哪些事必须上会，展示你对治理结构的理解

ex: Before we change the control architecture I need alignment with the client on the trade-off between cost and uptime.
sc: 强调重大技术决策前需与客户达成一致
tip: 'I need alignment on ...' 比 'we should discuss' 更明确

ex: I need your buy-in today on the phased SAT approach so the site team can mobilise on Monday.
sc: 向老板争取对方案的明确认可，并说明紧迫性
tip: 争取 buy-in 时说明'拿到认可后能立刻启动什么'，推动当下决策

ex: We are getting pushback from the operations team on the night shifts; I propose a rotation plan and will discuss it with their shift leaders.
sc: 说明来自某方的阻力及化解方案
tip: 报 pushback 时客观描述对方诉求，再给方案，不要评价对方态度

ex: This is expectation management: I have told the client in writing that a July go-live is not achievable without the second shift.
sc: 主动管理客户对工期的不合理预期，并留书面记录
tip: 预期管理必须'提前 + 书面'，事后解释一律大打折扣

ex: I would rather report the four-day slippage now than hide it until the milestone; transparency is the basis of trust on this project.
sc: 主动暴露问题，向老板表明汇报原则
tip: 德式管理最看重这一点：坏消息早说，比好消息晚说价值高得多
